Cebuano: Sa pagsugod sa Dios pagbuhat sa kalibotan ug sa tanang butang sa kalangitan,
English: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

Cebuano: ang kalibota n haw -ang ug walay hitsura Ang kadagatan gitabonan sa kangitngit ug ang Espiritu sa Dios naglihok ibabaw sa katubigan.
English: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Dios “Motungha ang kahayag” Ug mitungha ang kahayag.
English: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

Cebuano: Nahimuot ang Dios sa kahayag nga iyang nakita ug gilain niya k ini gikan sa kangitngit.
English: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

Cebuano: Ginganlan niyag “Adlaw” ang kahayag ug ang kangitngit ginganlan niyag “Gabii.” Milabay ang kagabhion ug miabot ang kabuntagon Mao kadto ang unang adlaw.
English: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Dios “Motungha ang usa ka wanang nga magbahin sa katubigan.” Ug nahimo kini.
English: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

Cebuano: Pinaagi sa gibuhat niyang wanang gilain sa Dios ang tubig nga didto sa ibabaw gikan sa tubig nga dinhi sa ubos ug nahimo kini.
English: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

Cebuano: Ginganlan niyag “Langit” ang wanang Milabay na usab ang kagabhion ug miabot ang kabuntagon. Mao kadto ang ikaduhang adlaw.
English: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Dios, “Matingob sa usa lamang ka dapit ang tubig ubos sa langit aron motungha ang yutang mala.” Ug nahimo kini.
English: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

Cebuano: Ginganlan sa Dios ug “Yuta” ang mala ug ang tubig nga nalain ginganlan niyag “Dagat.” Nakita sa Dios nga maayo ang iyang gibuhat.
English: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

Cebuano: Unya miingon siya “Moturok sa yuta ang nagkalainlaing mga tanom: kadtong may binhi ug kadtong mga kahoy nga mamunga.” Ug nahimo kini.
English: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

Cebuano: Busa miturok sa yuta ang tanang matang sa tanom Nakita sa Dios nga maayo ang iyang gibuhat.
English: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

Cebuano: Milabay na usab ang kagabhion ug miabot ang kabuntagon. Kadto mao ang ikatulong adlaw.
English: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

Cebuano: Unya miingon na usab ang Dios “Motungha ang mga iwag diha sa langit nga maoy magbulag sa adlaw gikan sa gabii ug magpaila sa pagsugod sa mga adlaw ug sa mga tuig ug sa mahinungdanong mga panahon.
English: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

Cebuano: Modan-ag kini sila sa kalangitan aron paghatag ug kahayag sa kalibotan” Ug nahimo kini.
English: and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

Cebuano: Busa gibuhat sa Dios ang duha ka dagkong iwag: ang adlaw nga maoy maghatag ug kahayag sa panahon sa adlaw ug ang bulan sa panahon sa gabii. Gibuhat usab niya ang mga bituon.
English: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

Cebuano: Gipahimutang sa Dios ang mga iwag diha sa langit aron magdan -ag sa kalibotan
English: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to giv e light upon the earth,

Cebuano: ug maghatag ug kahayag sa adlaw ug sa gabii ug maglain sa kahayag gikan sa kangitngit. Nakita sa Dios nga maayo ang iyang gibuhat.
English: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

Cebuano: Unya milabay na usab ang kagabhion ug miabot ang kabuntagon Kadto mao ang ikaupat nga adlaw.
English: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

Cebuano: Miingon na usab ang Dios “Mapuno ang katubigan sa nagkalainlaing mga buhing mananap ug mapuno usab sa mga langga m ang kahanginan” Ug nahimo kini.
English: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

Cebuano: Busa gibu hat sa Dios ang mga dagkong mananap sa kadagatan ug ang tanang matang sa mananap sa katubigan ug ang tanang matang sa langgam Nakita sa Dios nga maayo ang iyang gibuhat.
English: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought fort h abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

Cebuano: Unya gipanalanginan sa Dios ang mga mananap sa kadagatan ug giingnan “Sanay kamo u g lukpa ninyo ang kadagatan!” Ngadto sa mga langgam miingon siya, “Sanay kamo!”
English: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

Cebuano: Ug milabay ang kagabhion ug miabot ang kabun tagon. Kadto mao ang ikalimang adlaw.
English: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Dios “Motungha sa kalibotan ang nagkalainlaing mga mananap: mga kahayopa n ug tanang matang sa mga ihalas nga mananap” Ug nahimo kini.
English: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

Cebuano: Busa gibuhat niya ang tanang matang sa mga kahayopan ug mga ihalas nga mananap. Nakita sa Dios nga maayo ang iyang gibuhat ug nalipay siya.
English: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

Cebuano: Unya miingon na usab ang Dios “Buhaton nato ang tawo sama sa atong dagway. Sila maoy magbuot sa mga isda, sa mga langgam, sa mga kahayopan ug sa tanang ihalas nga mananap.”
English: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

Cebuano: Busa gibuhat sa Dios ang tawo, lalaki ug babaye, sama sa iyang dagway.
English: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

Cebuano: Ug gipanalanginan sila sa Dios nga nag-ingon, “Panganak kamog daghan ug lukpa ang kalibotan sa inyong mga liwat ug dumalaha ang kalibotan Kamoy magbuot sa mga isda ug sa mga langgam ug sa tanang ihalas nga mananap.”
English: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Dios, “Gihatag ko kaninyo ang tanang matang sa tanom nga may binhi ug ang tanang bunga sa kahoy aron inyong kan-on.
English: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

Cebuano: Gihatag ko usab sa tanang ihalas nga mananap ug sa kalanggaman ang mga tanom nga lunhaw aron ilang kan-on.” Ug nahimo kini.
English: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

Cebuano: Nakita sa Dios nga maayo gayod ang tanan nga iyang gibuhat ug nalipay kaayo siya. Milabay na usab ang kagabhion ug miabot ang kabuntagon Ug kadto mao ang ikaunom nga adlaw.
English: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

Cebuano: Nahuman pagbuhat ang langit ug ang yuta ug ang tanang butang nga anaa niini.
English: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

Cebuano: Sa ikapitong adlaw nahuman sa Dios ang tanan niyang gibuhat ug mipahulay siya gikan sa tanan niyang gibuhat.
English: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

Cebuano: Gipanalanginan sa Dios ang ikapitong adlaw ug gibalaan niya kini kay sa maong adlaw natapos niya ang iyang pagpamuhat ug mipahulay siya gikan sa tanan niyang gibuhat.
English: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made. Man in the Garden of Eden

Cebuano: Ingon niini ang pagbuhat sa kalibotan ug sa tanan nga anaa sa langit. Ang Tanaman sa Eden Sa pagbuhat sa Ginoong Dios sa kalibotan ug sa tanang butang sa kalangitan,
English: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

Cebuano: wala pay mga tanom nga mitubo ug mga binhi nga miturok sa yuta kay wala pa man niya kini paulani ug wala pa may tawo nga makauma niini.
English: and every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

Cebuano: Apan bisag walay ulan, diha nay tubig nga mitungha gikan sa ilalom sa yuta ug mipatubig niini.
English: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

Cebuano: Unya mikuha ang Ginoong Dios ug yuta ug nagbuhat siyag tawogikan niini Gihuypan niya ang buho sa ilong sa tawo sa gininhawa nga naghatag ug kinabuhi ug ang tawo nakabaton ug kinabuhi.
English: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

Cebuano: Unya naghimo ang Ginoong Dios ug tanaman didto sa Eden sa silangan ug gibutang niya didto ang tawo nga iyang gibuhat.
English: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

Cebuano: Gipatubo sa Ginoong Dios ang tanang matang sa mga kahoy nga maanindot ug mamungag mga bunga nga maayong kan -on. Sa taliwala sa tanaman diha ang kahoy nga naghatag ug kinabuhi ug ang kahoy nga naghatag ug kahibalo unsay maayo ug unsay daotan.
English: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

Cebuano: Gikan sa Eden midagayday ang usa ka suba nga maoy mipatubig sa tanaman, ug sa nasaylo na kini sa tanaman, ang suba nabahin sa upat.
English: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

Cebuano: Ang unang suba ginganlag Pison ug midagayday kini libot sa kayutaan sa Habila.
English: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Hav´ilah, where there is gold;

Cebuano: Makaplagan niining dapita ang lunsayng bulawan ingon man ang mga bato nga bedelyo ug sardonika nga pula.
English: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

Cebuano: Ang ngalan sa ikaduhang suba Gihon ug midagayday kini libot sa kayutaan sa Cus.
English: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

Cebuano: Ang ikatulong suba mao ang Tigris nga nagdagayday sa silangan sa Asiria Ang ikaupat nga suba mao ang Eufrates.
English: And the name of the third river is Hid´dekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphra´tes.

Cebuano: Unya gibutang sa Ginoong Dios ang tawo sa tanaman sa Eden aron maoy mag-atiman ug magbantay niini.
English: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

Cebuano: Giingnan niya ang taw o, “Makahimo ka pagkaon sa mga bunga sa tanang kahoy sa tanaman
English: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

Cebuano: gawas sa kahoy nga naghatag sa kahibalo unsay maayo ug unsay daotan Kon mokaon ka niini, nianang adlawa mamatay ka gayod.”
English: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and e vil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Ginoong Dios, “Dili maayo nga mag -inusara ang t awo. Himoan ko siyag kauban ug katabang nga angay kaniya.”
English: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.

Cebuano: Busa giumol niya gikan sa yuta ang tanang mananap ug langgam ug gidala niya sila ngadto sa tawo aron iyang nganlan Bisag unsa ang ingalan sa tawo sa matag usa kanila mao na ang ngalan niini.
English: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

Cebuano: Busa ginganlan sa tawo ang tanang kahayopan ug ang mga langgam ingon man ang ihalas nga mga mananap Apan wala siyay nakit -an nga angayng ikauban ug katabang.
English: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found a help meet for him.

Cebuano: Unya gipakatulog sa Ginoong Dios ang tawo ug samtang nahinanok siya gikuhaan siya sa Ginoong Dios ug gusok ug gihulipan niya kinig unod.
English: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof.

Cebuano: Ang maong gusok gihimo niya nga usa ka babaye ug gidala niya ang babaye ngadto sa lalaki.
English: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

Cebuano: Ug miingon ang lalaki "Ania ra gayod ang sama kanako — bukog gikan sa akong bukog ug unod gikan sa akong unod 'Babaye’ ang ngalan niya kay gikuha man siya gikan sa lalaki.”
English: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

Cebuano: Tungod niini ang lalaki mobiya sa iyang amahan ug inahan ug motipon sa iyang asawa ug mausa sila.
English: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

Cebuano: Silang duha pulos hubo apan wala sila maulaw.
English: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

Cebuano: Sa tanang mananap nga gibuhat sa Ginoong Dios, ang bitin mao ang labing limbongan. Gipangutana sa bitin ang babaye, “Gidid-an ba diay kamo sa Dios pagkaon sa bunga sa tanang kahoy sa tanaman?”
English: Now the serpent was more subtile than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

Cebuano: Mitubag ang babaye “Makakaon kami sa mga bunga sa tanang kahoy sa tanaman
English: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

Cebuano: gawas sa kahoy nga anaa sa taliwala niini. Gidid-an kami sa Dios sa pagkaon ug bisan gani sa paghikap nianang kahoya. Kon supakon namo kini, mamatay kami.”
English: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

Cebuano: Miingon ang bitin, “Dili tinuod nga mamatay kamo!
English: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

Cebuano: Gisulti kini sa Dios kaninyo kay nasayod man gud s iya nga kon mokaon kamo niini maabli ang inyong salabotan ug mahisama kamo kaniya nga nasayod unsay maayo ug unsay daotan.”
English: for God doth know that in the d ay ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

Cebuano: Sa pagkakita sa babaye nga ang maong kahoy maanindot kaayo ug laming kan-on ang bunga niini ug makapahimo kaniyang maalamon mikuha siyag bunga ug gikaon niya kini Unya gihatagan niya ang iyang bana ug mikaon usab siya.
English: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

Cebuano: Pagkahuman gayod nilag kaon, naabli ang ilang salabotan ug nakita nila nga hubo diay sila. Busa naghimo silag mga tapis gikan sa mga dahon sa kahoyng igera aron itabon sa ilang lawas.
English: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

Cebuano: Sa pagsalop na sa adlaw nadungog nila ang Ginoong Dios nga naglakaw sa tanaman busa mitago sila sa kakahoyan.
English: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.

Cebuano: Apan ang lalaki gitawag sa Ginoong Dios, “Hain ka ba?”
English: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?

Cebuano: Ang lalaki mitubag “Nadungog ko ang imong paglakaw sa tanaman ug giabot akog kahadlok ug mitago ako kay hubo man ako.”
English: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

Cebuano: “Kinsay nagsulti kanimo nga hubo ka?” nangutana ang Dios. “Mikaon ka ba sa bunga sa kahoy nga gidili ko kanimo?”
English: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

Cebuano: Ang lalaki mitubag “Ang babaye nga gihatag mo kanako maoy naghatag kanako sa bunga sa maong kahoy ug mikaon ako niini.”
English: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

Cebuano: Ang Ginoong Dios nangutana sa babaye “Nganong gibuhat mo man kini?” Ang babaye mitubag, “Giilad ako sa bitin busa mikaon ako niini.” Mipahamtang ug Silot ang Dios
English: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

Cebuano: Ug ang Ginoong Dios miingon sa bitin "Tungod niini silotan ka; ikaw lamang sa tanang mananap ang mahiagom niining tungloha: sukad karon magkamang ka na pinaagi sa imong tiyan ug magkaon ka nag abog sa tanang adlaw sa imong kinabuhi.
English: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

Cebuano: Himoon kong magkaaway ikaw ug ang babaye; ug mahimong kaaway ang imong k aliwat ug ang iyang kaliwat Dugmokon niya ang imong ulo ug paakon mo usab ang iyang tikod.”
English: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

Cebuano: Ug miingon siya sa babaye "Dugangan ko ang imong kalisdanan inigpanamkon mo ug ang kasakit nga imong bation inigpanganak nimo; apan bisan pa niini, mangandoy ka gihapon sa imong bana ug siya maoy magbuot kanimo.”
English: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

Cebuano: Unya miingon siya sa lalaki "Tungod kay nagpadani ka man sa imong asawa ug mikaon sa bunga sa kahoy nga gidili ko kanimo mahimong tinunglo ang yuta tungod sa imong gibuhat Maghago ka pag -ayo sa tibu ok mong kinabuhi una pa kini mohatag ug igong abot alang kanimo.
English: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

Cebuano: Moturok sa yuta ang mga sampinit ug mga sagbot al ang kanimo ug magkaon ka sa mga bunga sa mga tanom sa kapatagan.
English: thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field:

Cebuano: Magpatulo ka sa imong singot ug maghago pag -ayo una pa mohatag kanimog ab ot ang yuta hangtod mobalik ka sa yuta nga imong gigikanan Hinimo ka gikan sa yuta ug sa yuta ka mopauli.”
English: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

Cebuano: Ginganlan sa lalaki ang iyang asawa ug Eva kay siya man ang inahan sa tanang mga tawo.
English: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

Cebuano: Ug nagbuhat ang Ginoong Dios alang kang Adan ug kang Eva ug mga sapot nga panit sa mga mananap ug gibistihan niya sila. Si Adan ug si Eva Gipapahawa gikan sa Tanaman
English: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Ginoong Dios, “Karon ang tawo nahisama na kanato ug nahibalo na siya unsay maayo ug unsay daotan. Kinahanglan dili siya tugotan pagkaon sa bunga sa kahoy nga naghatag ug kinabuhi aron dili siya magpabiling buhi hangtod sa kahangtoran.”
English: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

Cebuano: Busa gihinginlan sa Ginoong Dios ang tawo gikan sa tanaman sa Eden ug gipaugmad sa yuta nga iyang gigikanan.
English: therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

Cebuano: Gipapahawa sa Dios ang tawo ug gibu tangan niya ang silangan sa tanaman sa Eden ug mga kerubin ug usa ka espada nga nagdilaab ug nagtuyoktuyok aron walay makaduol sa kahoy nga naghatag ug kinabuhi.
English: So he drove out the man: and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

Cebuano: Si Adan nakighilawas kang Eva nga iyang asawa ug nanamkon si Eva ug nanganak ug batang lalaki. Miingon si Eva, “Nakabaton akog anak tungod sa panabang sa Ginoo.” Busa ginganlan niyag Cain ang bata.
English: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

Cebuano: Unya nanganak siyag laing batang lalaki nga ginganlan ug Abel Si Abel magbalantay sa mga karnero ug si Cain mag-uuma.
English: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

Cebuano: Usa ka adlaw niana, naghalad si Cain ngadto sa Ginoo ug mga abot sa iyang uma.
English: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

Cebuano: Nagkuhausab si Abel ug pipila sa mga panganay sa iyang kahayopan ug giihaw niya kini ug gihalad ang labing maayong mga bahin ngadto sa Ginoo. Nahimuot ang Ginoo kang Abel ug sa iyang halad
English: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

Cebuano: apan wala niya dawata si Cain ug ang iyang halad Busa nasuko si Cain ug nagmug-ot.
English: but unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

Cebuano: Ang Ginoo miingon kang Cain, “Nganong nasuko ug nagmug-ot ka man?
English: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

Cebuano: Kon maayo pa ang imong gibuhat, dawaton ko unta ang imong halad Apan kay daotan man, ang sala nag-atang kanimo sama sa ihalas nga mananap nga buot motukob kanimo busa kinahanglan buntogon mo kini.”
English: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door: and unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

Cebuano: Unya si Cain miingon kang Abel “Mangadto ta sa uma” Sa didto na sila sa kaumahan, giunay ni Cain pagpatay ang iyang igsoon.
English: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

Cebuano: Unya ang Ginoo nangutana kang Cain “Hain man si Abel nga imong igsoon?” Si Cain mitubag, “Ambot! Magbalantay ba gud ko sa akong igsoon?”
English: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?

Cebuano: Busa miingon ang Ginoo, “Nganong gihimo mo man kini? Nadungog ko ang dugo sa imong igsoon nga nagsangpit kanako gikan sa yuta.
English: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.

Cebuano: Karon tinunglo ka na ug isalikway ka sa yuta diin ang dugo sa imong igsoon nga imong gipatay miagas ug mituhop.
English: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand.

Cebuano: Kon mag-uma ka, ang yuta dili na mohatag kanimog abot Magtagotago ka ug maglatagaw nga walay pinuy-anan sa kalibotan.”
English: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

Cebuano: Si Cain miingon sa Ginoo, “Bug-at ra kaayo kanako kining silota.
English: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.

Cebuano: Giabog mo ako gikan niining yutaa ug gikan sa imong atubangan Maglatagaw ug magtagotago ako sa kalibotan ug patyon ako ni bisan kinsa nga makakita kanako.”
English: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.

Cebuano: Apan ang Ginoo mitubag kaniya “Dili kana mahitabo! Ang m opatay kanimo panimaslan ug silotan ko ug pito ka pilo” Busa gibutangan sa Ginoo ug patik si Cain aron dili siya patyon sa makakita kaniya.
English: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

Cebuano: Ug si Cain mipahilayo sa Ginoo ug mipuyo sa yuta nga ginganlag Nod sa silangan sa Eden. Ang mga Kaliwat ni Cain
English: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

Cebuano: Si Cain nakighilawas sa iyang asawa Nanamkon ang iyang asawa ug nanganak ug batang lalaki nga ginganlan nilag Enoc Unya nagtukod si Cain ug siyudad nga ginganlan niyag Enoc agig pasidungog sa iyang anak.
English: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

Cebuano: Si Enoc may anak nga ginganlag Irad nga mao ang amahan ni Mehujael ug si Mehujael maoy amahan ni Metusael. Si Metusael maoy amahan ni Lamec.
English: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehu´ja-el: and Mehu´ja-el begat Methu´sa-el: and Methu´sa-el begat Lamech.

Cebuano: Duha ang asawa ni Lamec: si Ada ug si Zilla.

Cebuano: Si Ada nanganak kang Jabal nga mao ang amahan sa mga nagbuhig kahayopan ug nagpuyo sa mga tolda.
English: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

Cebuano: Ang ngalan sa iyang igsoon mao si Jubal nga mao ang amahan sa tanang musikero nga nagatugtog sa alpa ug sa plawta.
English: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

Cebuano: Unya nanganak si Zilla kang Tubal -Cain nga mao ang ginikanan sa tanang tiggama ug mga butang gikan sa bronsi ug puthaw Ang igsoong babaye ni Tubal-Cain mao si Naama.
English: And Zillah, she also bare Tu´bal –cain, an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tu´bal–cain was Na´amah.

Cebuano: Si Lamec miingon sa iyang duha ka asawa "Ada ug Zilla, paminawa ninyo ako. Nakapatay akog batan-ong lalaki tungod kay gisumbag niya ako.
English: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

Cebuano: Kon ang panimalos alang kang Cain pito ka pilo ang panimalos alang kanako kapitoan ug pito ka pilo.” Ang mga Kaliwat ni Set
English: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

Cebuano: Unya nakighilawas na usab si Adan sa iyang asawa ug si Eva nanganak ug batang lalaki. Si Eva miingon, “Gihatagan ako sa Dios ug anak ilis kang Abel nga gipatay ni Cain.” Busa ginganlan niya ang bata ug Set.

Cebuano: Mao kini ang talaan sa mga kaliwat ni Adan. Ang tawo gibuhat sa Dios sama kaniya.

English: and Mahal´aleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

English: and all the days of Mahal´aleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

English: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

English: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

English: and Enoch walked with God after he begat Methu´selah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

Cebuano: Miabot ang iyang panuigon ug
English: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

English: And Methu´selah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

English: and Methu´selah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

Cebuano: ug namatay siya sa panuigong

English: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

English: and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

Cebuano: Nabuhi pa si Lamec ug laing ka tuig ug nakaliwat ug ubang mga anak
English: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

Cebuano: ug unya namatay siya sa panuigong
English: and all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

English: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

Cebuano: Niadtong panahona daghan na ang mga tawo sa kalibotan ug maanyag ang ilang mga anak nga babaye Nakita kini sa pipila ka langitnong mga binuhat ug gipangasawa nila ang ilang nagustohan.
English: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them, that the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

Cebuano: Unya ang Ginoo miingon, “Dili ko tugotan ang tawo nga mabuhi hangtod sa kahangtoran kay tawo lamang siya Sukad karon kutob ra gayod sa 120 ka tuig ang ilang kinabuhi.”
English: And the LORD said, My Spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be a hundred and twenty years.

Cebuano: Niadtong mga adlawa ug bisan pa gani sa misunod nga panahon dihay mga higante sa kalibotan. Sila mga anak sa mga babaye nga sama na to ug sa mga langitnong binuhat Sila mao ang mga bayani ug mga bantogang tawo sa karaang panahon.
English: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

Cebuano: Unya nakita sa Ginoo nga hilabihan kadaotan sa mga tawo sa kalibotan ug kanunay lamang ngil-ad ang ilang gihunahuna.
English: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

Cebuano: Nagbasol siya nga gibuhat niya ang taw o diha sa kalibotan ug nakapasubo kini kaniya.
English: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

Cebuano: Busa miingon siya “Laglagon ko ang tanang tawo nga akong gibuhat Laglagon ko usab ang tanang mananap ug mga langgam kay nagbasol ako nga gibuhat ko sila.”
English: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

Cebuano: Apan gikahimut-an sa Ginoo si Noe. Naghimo si Noe ug Arka
English: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD. Noah Makes the Ark

Cebuano: Mao kini ang sugilanon mahitungod ni Noe nga usa ka matarong nga tawo Siya lamang ang gikahimut -an sa Dios niadtong panahona kay nagmatinumanon man siya sa Dios.
English: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

Cebuano: Aduna siyay tulo ka anak: Si Sem, si Ham ug si Japet.
English: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

Cebuano: Apan ang katawhan daotan a tubangan sa Dios ug ang kalibotan napuno sa ilang pagkadaotan.
English: The earth also was corrupt before God; and the earth was filled with violence.

Cebuano: Gitan-aw sa Dios ang kalibotan ug nakita niya nga ngil -ad kini kay daotan man kaayo ang binuhatan sa mga tawo.
English: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

Cebuano: Unya ang Dios miingon kang Noe “Nakahukom ako sa paglaglag sa tanang tawo. Puohon ko sila sa hingpit kay ila mang gipadagsang sa kalibotan ang ilang daotang mga buhat.
English: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

Cebuano: Busa paghimog arka gikan sa kahoy nga goper Buhati kinig mga lawak ug buliti ug aspalto ang sulod ug ang gawas niini.
English: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

Cebuano: Ang gitas-on niini 133 ka metros, 22 ka metros ang gilapdon ug 13 ka metros ang kahabugon.
English: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

Cebuano: Buhatig atop ang arka ug palabwa kini ug 44 ka sentimetros ibabaw sa mga bungbong niini. Himoa ang arka nga tulo ka andana ug buhatig pultahan sa kilid niini.
English: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt tho u finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.

Cebuano: Palunopan ko ang kalibotan aron pagpuo sa tanang binuhat. Ang tanan nga anaa ibabaw sa yuta mangamatay
English: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of lif e, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

Cebuano: apan magbuhat akog kasabotan tali kanimo ug kanako. Sakay sa arka uban sa imong asawa ug mga anak ug sa ilang mga asawa.
English: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

Cebuano: Pagdalag laki ug baye sa tanang matang sa mga mananap ug sa matag matang sa mga langgam aron dili sila mapuo.
English: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female. Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind; two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.

Cebuano: Pagdala usab sa tanang matang sa pagkaon ug tipigi kini aron inyong makaon ug makaon usab sa mga mananap.”
English: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

Cebuano: Gituman ni Noe kining tanan sumala sa gisugo sa Dios kaniya.
English: Thus did Noah according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

Cebuano: Ang Ginoo miingon kan g Noe “Sakay sa arka uban sa tibuok mong panimalay kay sa tanang mga tawo ikaw lamang ang nagbuhat ug matarong.
English: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

Cebuano: Pagdala ug pito ka parisan nga laki ug baye sa tanang mananap nga giisip nga hinlo apan tagsa ka paris lamang ang dad -a sa mga mananap nga gii sip nga hugaw.
English: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

Cebuano: Pagdala usab ug pito ka parisan nga laki ug baye sa mga langgam aron dili sila mapuo.
English: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

Cebuano: Ug gituman ni Noe ang tanan nga gisugo sa Ginoo kaniya.
English: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.

Cebuano: Si Noe nagpanuigon ug sa dihang gilunopan ang kalibotan.

Cebuano: Siyaug ang iyang asawa ingon man ang ilang mga anak uban sa ilang mga asawa nanakay sa arka aron dili sila mangamatay sa lunop.
English: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

Cebuano: Ang tanang matang sa mananap nga hinlo ug dili hinlo ingon man sa mga langgam
English: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

Cebuano: nanakay sa arka nga nagtinagurha laki ug baye, kuyog kang Noe sumala sa gisugo sa Dios kaniya.
English: there went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

English: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

English: they, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

English: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.

English: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged.

English: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.

English: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ar´arat.

English: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

English: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

Cebuano: ug gibuhian niya ang usa ka uwak Wala kini mobalik apan naglupadlupad kini hangtod nga mihubas ang tubig.
English: and he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

Cebuano: Unya gibuhian ni Noe ang usa ka salampati aron pa gsusi kon mihubas na ba ang tubig.
English: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground.

Cebuano: Apan kay gisanapan pa man sa tubig ang yuta, walay hikaplagan nga katugdonan ang salampati ug mibalik kini sa arka Busa gipagawas ni Noe ang iyang kamot sa arka ug gikuha ang salampati.
English: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark; for the waters were on the face of the whole earth. Then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

Cebuano: Naghulat siyag laing pito ka adlaw ug gibuhian niya pag -usab ang salampati.
English: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark.

Cebuano: Sa pagkakilomkilom na mibalik kini kaniya nga nagtangag ug lunhawng dahon sa kahoyng olibo Sa ingon niana, nasayran ni Noe nga mihubas na gayod ang tubig.
English: And the dove came in to him in the evening, and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

Cebuano: Unya naghulat pa gayod si Noe ug laing pito ka adlaw ug gibuhian na usab niya ang salampati ug wala na kini mobalik.
English: And he stayed yet other seven days, and sent forth the dove, which returned not again unto him any more.

Cebuano: Sa na ang panuigon ni Noe sa unang adlaw, sa unang bulan, mihubas na gayod sa hingpit ang tubig Human niya makuha ang tabon sa arka milantaw si Noe ug nakita niya nga uga na ang yuta.
English: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

Cebuano: Sa ika-27 nga adlaw, sa ikaduhang bulan, namala na gayod ang yuta.
English: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

Cebuano: Unya ang Dios miingon kang Noe,
English: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

Cebuano: “Kawas na sa arka uban sa imong asawa ug mga anak ug sa ilang mga asawa.
English: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wif e, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

Cebuano: Pagulaa usab ang tanang mananap —ang mga langgam, mga kahayopan ug ang tanang gagmayng mananap—aron mosanay sila sa tibuok kalibotan.”
English: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

Cebuano: Busa mikawas si Noe uban sa iyang asawa ug mg a anak ug sa ilang mga asawa.
English: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

Cebuano: Sumala sa ilang matang ang tanang ihalas nga mga mananap mga kahayopan, mga langgam ug gagmayng mga mananap nanggawas usab sa arka. Naghalad si Noe
English: every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

Cebuano: Si Noe nagbuhat ug halaran alang sa Ginoo ug mikuha siyag usa sa matag matang sa hinlo nga mga mananap ug mga langgam ug gisunog niya kini ingon nga halad.
English: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

Cebuano: Sa napanimahuan sa Ginoo ang kahumot niini miingon siya sa iyang kaugalingon, “Dili ko na gayod tunglohon ang yuta tungod sa gibuhat sa tawo. Nasayod ako nga sukad pa sa iyang pagkabatan -on, daotan na ang iyang hunahuna Dili ko na gayod laglagon ang tanang binuhat nga buhi sama sa akong gibuhat.
English: And the LORD smelled a sweet savor; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth: neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

Cebuano: Samtang ania pa ang kalibotan dili gayod matapos ang panahon sa tingtanom ug ang panahon s a ting-ani, ang tingtugnaw ug ang ting -init, ang tinghulaw ug ang ting-ulan, ang adlaw ug ang gabii.”
English: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

Cebuano: Gipanalanginan sa Dios si Noe ug ang iyang mga anak ug giingnan “Panganak kamo aron ang inyong mga liwat mosanay sa kalibotan.
English: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

Cebuano: Mangahadlok kaninyo ang tanang mananap lakip ang mga langgam ang gagmayng mga mananap ug ang mga isda Gitugyan sila ubos sa inyong pagbuot.
English: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

Cebuano: Makakaon kamo sa tanang mananap ug sa lunhawng mga tanom kay gitugyan ko kining tanan kaninyo aron mahimong pagkaon ninyo.
English: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

Cebuano: Usa lamang ka butang ang kinahanglan dili ninyo kan -on ug kini mao ang karne nga may dugo pa kay ang kinabuhi anaa man sa dugo.
English: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

Cebuano: Kon usa ka tawo mopatay ug tawo, silotan siya Silotan pinaagi sa kamatayon ang mananap o tawo nga mopatay ug tawo.
English: And surely your blood of your lives will I require: at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

Cebuano: Ang mopatay ug tawo patyon usab sa iyang isigkatawo; kay gibuhat man ang tawo sama sa Dios.
English: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his b lood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

Cebuano: “Panganak kamo aron modaghan kamo ug molukop sa tibuok kalibotan.”
English: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

Cebuano: Unya ang Dios miingon kang Noe ug sa iyang mga anak,
English: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

Cebuano: “Himoon ko na karon a ng akong kasabotan tali kaninyo ug kanako ug sa inyong mga kaliwat,
English: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

Cebuano: ingon man sa tanang binuhat nga buhi uban kaninyo —ang mga langgam mga kahayopan ug mga ihalas nga mga mananap —tanan gayod nga nanggawas sa arka.
English: and with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

Cebuano: Himoon ko ang akong kasabotan tali kan inyo ug kanako: isaad ko nga dili na gayod puohon pinaagi sa lunop ang tanang binuhat nga buhi Dili na gayod laglagon ang kalibotan pinaagi sa lunop.”
English: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

Cebuano: Ug ang Dios miingon “Agig timaan sa walay kataposang kasabotan nga akong gihimo tali kanako ug kaninyo ingon man sa tanang buhing mananap,
English: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you, and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

Cebuano: palutawon ko ang akong bangaw diha sa kapanganoran Timaan kini sa kasabotan tali kanako ug sa kalibotan.
English: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

Cebuano: Kon tigumon ko na gani ang mga panganod diha sa langit ug makita diha niini ang bangaw,
English: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

Cebuano: hinumdoman ko ang akong gisaad kaninyo ug sa tanang mananap nga dili ko na gayod laglagon pinaagig lunop ang tanang binuhat.
English: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

Cebuano: Sa dihang makita na ang bangaw diha sa mga panganod tan-awon ko kini ug hinumdoman ko ang walay kataposang kasabotan tali kanako ug sa tanang binuhat nga anaa sa kalibotan.”
English: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

Cebuano: Ang Dios miingon kang Noe “Mao kini ang ilhanan sa saad nga akong gihimo sa tanang binuhat nga buhi dinhi sa kalibotan.” Si Noe ug ang Iyang mga Anak
English: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth. Noah's Drunkenness

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Noe nga nangawas sa arka mao si Sem si Ham ug si Japet. Si Ham mao ang amahan ni Canaan.
English: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

Cebuano: Kining tulo ka anak n i Noe mao ang mga ginikanan sa tanang tawo sa kalibotan.
English: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

Cebuano: Si Noe mag-uuma ug siya mao ang unang nananom ug paras.
English: And Noah began to be a husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

Cebuano: Sa nakainom na siyag ubay-ubayng bino, nahubog siya ug natulog nga hubo didto sa iyang tolda.
English: and he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

Cebuano: Sa pagkakita ni Ham, ang amahan ni Canaan, nga hubo ang iyang amahan, migula siya ug gisuginlan ang duha niya ka igsoon.
English: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

Cebuano: Unya nagkuhag kupo sila si Sem ug si Japet ug gibutang nila kini sa ilang abaga. Nagtalikod sila nga misulod sa tolda ug gitabonan nila ang ilang amahan. Samtang gibuhat nila kini milingiw sila aron dili nila makita ang pagkahubo sa ilang amahan.
English: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

Cebuano: Sa nahuwasan na si Noe ug sa nasayra n niya ang gibuhat kaniya sa iyang kamanghorang anak,
English: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

Cebuano: miingon siya "Tinunglo si Canaan; mahimo siyang ulipon sa iyang mga igsoon.”
English: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

Cebuano: Miingon usab siya, "Dalaygon ang Dios ni Sem. Mahimong ulipon ni Sem si Canaan.
English: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

Cebuano: Pasanayon unta sa Dios si Japet ug motipon unta pagpuyo sa katawhan ni Sem ang iyang kaliwat. Mahimong ulipon ni Japet si Canaan.”
English: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

Cebuano: Human sa lunop, nabuhi pa si Noe ug laing ka tuig.
English: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

Cebuano: Namatay siya sa panuigong
English: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

Cebuano: Mao kini ang mga kaliwat sa mga anak ni Noe nga sila si Sem si Ham ug si Japet. Ang ilang mga anak nangatawo human sa lunop.
English: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah; Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Japet mao sila si Gomer Magog, Madai, Jaban, Tubal, Mesec ug Tiras.
English: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Ma´dai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Gomer mao sila si Askenas, Rifat ug Togarma.
English: And the sons of Gomer; Ash´kenaz, and Riphath, and Togar´mah.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Jaban mao sila si Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ug Dodanim.
English: And the sons of Javan; Eli´shah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Do´danim.

Cebuano: Sila maoy mga ginikanan sa mga tawo nga nagpuyo sa kabaybayonan ug sa mga pulo sa dagat Mao kini ang mga kaliwat ni Japet nga nagpuyo sa ilang nagkalainlaing kabanayan ug kanasoran. Ang matag usa nila ka pundok may kaugalingong pinulongan.
English: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Ham mao sila si Cus, si Ehipto, si Put ug si Canaan.
English: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Miz´ra-im, and Phut, and Canaan.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Cus mao sila si Seba si Habila, si Sabta, si Raama ug si Sabteca. Ang mga anak ni Raama mao sila si Sheba ug Dedan.
English: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Hav´ilah, and Sabtah, and Ra´amah, and Sab´techa: and the sons of Ra´amah; Sheba, and Dedan.

Cebuano: May anak si Cus nga ginganlag Nimrod nga maoy unang bantogang tawo sa kalibotan.
English: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

Cebuano: Pinaagi sa tabang sa Ginoo nahimo siyang labing maayong mangangayam sa tibuok kalibotan busa ang mga tawo moingon, “Himoon ka unta sa Ginoo nga sama ka maayong mangangayam ni Nimrod.”
English: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

Cebuano: Ang unang gingharian nga iyang gimandoan naglakip sa Babel Erac u g Acad. Nahimutang kini sila sa yuta sa Shinar.
English: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

Cebuano: Gikan sa maong yuta mipanaw si Nimrod paingon sa Asiria ug gitukod niya ang mga siyudad sa Ninibe, Rehobot-Ir, Cala
English: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nin´eveh, and the city Reho´both, and Calah,

Cebuano: ug Resen nga diha sa tungatunga sa Ninibe ug sa dakong siyudad sa Cala.
English: and Resen between Nin´eveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

Cebuano: Si Ehipto maoy ginikanan sa katawhan sa Ludim sa Anamim, sa Lahabim, sa Naftuhim,
English: And Miz´ra-im begat Ludim, and An´amim, and Le´habim, and Naph´tuhim,

Cebuano: Petrusim, Caftorim ug Casluhim nga maoy gigikanan sa mga Filistihanon.
English: and Path´rusim, and Cas´luhim,  and Caph´torim.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Canaan mao sila si Sidon, ang kamagulangan, ug si Het.
English: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

Cebuano: Kaliwat usab ni Canaan ang mga Jebusiha non, ang mga Amorihanon ang mga Girgasihanon,
English: and the Jeb´usite, and the Amorite, and the Gir´gashite,

Cebuano: ang mga Hibihanon, ang mga Arkihanon, ang mga Sinaihanon,
English: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

Cebuano: ang mga Arvadihanon ang mga Semarihanon ug ang mga Hamatihanon Unya, nagbulagbulag ang nagkalainlaing mga banay sa mga taga-Canaan
English: and the Ar´vadite, and the Zem´arite, and the Ha´mathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

Cebuano: hangtod nga ang ilang mga utlanan nagsukad sa Sidon padulong sa Gerar hangtod sa Gaza ug paingon sa Sodoma Gomora, Adma ug Zeboim, hangtod sa Lasa.
English: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest unto Sodom, and Gomor´rah, and Admah, and Zebo´im, even unto Lasha.

Cebuano: Mao kini ang mga kaliwat ni Ham nga nagpuyo sa nagkalainlaing mga kabanayan ug kanasoran Ang matag usa ka pundok may kaugalingong pinulongan.
English: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

Cebuano: Si Sem, ang magulang ni Japet, mao ang ginikanan sa tanang Hebreo.
English: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

Cebuano: Ang mga lalaking anak ni Sem mao sila si Elam si Asur, si Arfacsad, si Lud ug si Aram nga maoy mga ginikanan sa mga katawhan nga nagdala sa ilang mga ngalan.
English: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphax´ad, and Lud, and Aram.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Aram mao sila si Uz, si Hul, si Geter ug si Mas.
English: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

Cebuano: Si Arfacsad mao ang amahan ni Sela ug si Shela mao ang amahan ni Eber.
English: And Arphax´ad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

Cebuano: Duha ang anak ni Eber: ang usa ginganlag Peleg kay sa iyang panahon ang katawhan sa kalibotan nabahin man ug ang n galan sa iyang igsoon mao si Joctan.
English: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

Cebuano: Si Joctan mao ang amahan ni Almodad, Selap, Hasarmabet, Jera,
English: And Joktan begat Almo´dad, and Sheleph, and Ha´zar-ma´veth, and Jerah,

Cebuano: Hadoram, Uzal, Dicla,
English: and Hador´am, and Uzal, and Diklah,

Cebuano: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
English: and Obal, and Abim´a-el, and Sheba,

Cebuano: Ofir, Habila ug ni Jobab. Silang tanan mga anak ni Joctan.
English: and Ophir, and Hav´ilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

Cebuano: Ang yuta nga ilang gipuy -an nagsukad sa Mesa paingon sa Separ sa kabukiran dapit sa silangan.
English: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar, a mount of the east.

Cebuano: Mao kini sila ang mga kaliwat ni Sem nga nagpuyo sa ilang nagkalainlaing mga kabanayan ug kanasoran. Ang matag usa ka pundok may kaugalingong pinulongan.
English: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

Cebuano: Kining tanan mao ang mga banay sa mga kaliwat ni Noe sumala sa ilang tagsatagsa ka kaliwat ug nasod. Ang tanang kanasoran sa kalibotan naggikan niining mga anak ni Noe human sa lunop.
English: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

Cebuano: Sa sinugdan may usa lamang ka pinulongan sa tibuok kalibotan.
English: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

Cebuano: Sa pagpamalhin sa mga tawo gikan sa sidlakan, nahiabot sila sa usa ka patag sa Shinar ug mipuyo sila didto.
English: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

Cebuano: Ug nag-ingnanay sila, “Dali! Maghimo kitag tisa ug ipaagi nato kinig kalayo aron mogahi.” Busa nakabaton silag tisa ug aspalto aron ipatapot niini.
English: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.

Cebuano: Unya miingon sila, “Karon magbuhat kitag siyudad nga may tore nga sangko sa langit Himoon tang bantogan ang atong ngalan aron dili kita magkatibulaag sa tibuok kalibotan.”
English: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city, and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

Cebuano: Unya nanaog ang Ginoo aron pagtan-aw sa siyudad ug sa tore nga gitukod sa mga tawo
English: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

Cebuano: ug miingon ang Ginoo, “Karon usa na sila ka katawhan ug usa ra ang ilang pinulongan ug sinugdanan lamang kini sa ilang pagabuhaton Dili madugay makahimo na sila sa tanan nga gusto nilang buhaton.
English: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

Cebuano: Busa manganaog kita ug libogon ta ang ilang pinulongan aron dili sila magkasinabtanay.”
English: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

Cebuano: Busa gipatibulaag sila sa Ginoo sa tibuok kalibotan ug mihunong sila pagtukod sa siyudad.
English: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

Cebuano: Babel ang ngalan sa siyudad kay didto gilibog man sa Ginoo ang pinulongan sa tanang tawo ug gikan didto gipatibulaag niya sila sa tibuok kalibotan. Ang mga Kaliwat ni Sem
English: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth. The Descendants of Shem

Cebuano: Mao kini ang mga kaliwat ni Sem Duha ka tuig human sa lunop, sa dihan 100 na ka tuig si Sem, nakaliwat siyag lalaki nga si Arfacsad.
English: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was a hundred years old, and begat Arphax´ad two years after the flood:

Cebuano: Unya nakaabot pa siya ug laing ka tuig ug nakaliwat pa siyag ubang mga anak.
English: and Shem lived after he begat Arphax´ad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 35 na ang panuigon ni Arfacsad, nakaliwat siyag lalaki nga si Shela.
English: And Arphax´ad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

Cebuano: Unya nakaabot pa siya ug laing ka tuig ug may lain pa siyang mga anak.
English: And Arphax´ad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 30 na ang panuigon ni Shela natawo ang iyang anak nga lalaki nga si Eber.
English: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

Cebuano: Human matawo si Eber nakaabot pa si Shela ug laing ka tuig ug may lain pa siyang mga anak.
English: and Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 34 na ang panuigon ni Eber, may anak siyang lalaki nga si Peleg.
English: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

Cebuano: Human matawo si Peleg, nakaabot si Eber ug laing ka tuig ug nakaliwat pag ubang mga anak.
English: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 30 na ang panuigon ni Peleg, nakaliwat siyag lalaki nga si Reu.
English: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Re´u:

Cebuano: Human matawo si Reu nakaabot pa si Peleg ug laing ka tuig ug nakaliwat pag ubang mga anak.
English: and Peleg lived after he begat Re´u two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 32 na ang panuigon ni Reu, nakaliwat siyag lalaki nga si Serug.
English: And Re´u lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

Cebuano: Human niini nakaabot pa si Reu ug lai ng ka tuig ug nakaliwat pag ubang mga anak.
English: and Re´u lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 30 na ang panuigon ni Serug, nakaliwat siyag lalaki nga si Nahor.
English: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

Cebuano: Human matawo si Nahor nakaabot pa si Serug ug laing 200 ka tuig ug nakaliwat pag ubang mga anak.
English: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, a nd begat sons and daughters.

Cebuano: Sa 29 na ang panuigon ni Nahor, nakaliwat siyag lalaki nga si Tera.
English: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

Cebuano: Human niini, nakaabot pa si Nahor ug laing 119 ka tuig ug nakaliwat pag ubang mga anak.
English: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

English: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

English: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

English: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.

English: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

Cebuano: Inigkakita sa mga Ehiptohanon kanimo moingon gayod sila ‘Asawa kini niya,’ ug patyon ako nila apan ikaw dili.

Cebuano: Sa dihang miabot na si Abram sa Ehipto nakita tuod sa mga Ehiptohanon nga maanyag ang iyang asawa.

English: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

Cebuano: Apan tungod kay gikuha man ni Paraon si Sarai gipahamtangan sa Ginoo ug makalilisang nga mga sakit si Paraon ingon man ang namuyo sa iyang palasyo.
English: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues, because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

Cebuano: Busa gipatawag niya si Abram ug gipangutana “Unsa ba kining imong gihimo kanako? Nganong wala mo man ako tug -ani nga imo diay siyang asawa?
English: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

Cebuano: Nganong miingon ka man nga siya imong igsoon ug tungod niini gikuha ko siya aron mahimong akong asawa? Ania ang imong asawa; kuhaa siya ug panlakaw kamo!”
English: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.

Cebuano: Ug nagsugo si Paraon sa iyang mga tawo nga ubanan si Abram ug gidala nila siya ug gipagawas sa Ehipto uban sa iyang asawa ug sa tanan nga iyaha.
English: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

Cebuano: Gikan sa Ehipto mipaingon si Abram sa amihanan ngadto sa Negeb uban s a iyang asawa ug sa tanan nga iyaha. Mikuyog usab kaniya si Lot.
English: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

Cebuano: Dato na kaayo si Abram May mga karnero siya, mga kanding, mga baka ug mga plata ug bulawan.
English: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

Cebuano: Mipadayon si Abram gikan sa Negeb ngadto sa Betel, sa dapit nga iyang gitoldahan kaniadto, tungatunga sa Betel ug sa Ai.
English: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth–el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth–el and Ha´i;

Cebuano: Mibalik siya sa dapit diin nagbuhat siya kaniadto ug halaran ug gisimba niya didto ang Ginoo.
English: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

Cebuano: Si Lot nga mikuyog kang Abram may mga karnero usab mga kanding ug mga baka ug may mga tawo nga uban kaniya sa iyang pagkampo.
English: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

Cebuano: Ug tungod kay daghan na man kaayog kahayopan sila si Abram ug si Lot dili na paigo ang sibsibanan alang sa ilang mga kahayopan kon magtipon sila pagpuyo.
English: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

Cebuano: Busa nagkaaway ang mga magbalantay sa kahayopan ni Abr am ug ang mga magbalantay sa kahayopan ni Lot Niadtong panahona ang mga Canaanhon ug mga Perisihanon nagpuyo pa sa maong yuta.
English: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Per´izzite dwelt then in the land.

Cebuano: Unya miingon si Abram kang Lot “Dili angay mag -away ang imong mga tawo ug ang akoa kay paryenti man kita.
English: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

Cebuano: Busa magbulag kita Pagpilig yuta nga buot mong puy -an ug biya kanako Kon adto ka sa usa ka dapit, adto ako sa lain.”
English: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from m e: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

Cebuano: Busa gilukop ni Lot pagtan -aw ang palibot ug nakita niya nga ang tibuok Walog sa Jordan hangtod ngadto sa Zoar daghag tubig sama sa tanaman sa Ginoo o sam a sa yuta sa Ehipto Nahitabo kini sa wala pa laglaga sa Ginoo ang mga siyudad sa Sodoma ug Gomora.
English: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomor´rah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zo´ar.

Cebuano: Gipili ni Lot ang tibuok Walog sa Jordan ug mipanaw siya padulong sa sidlakan. Sa ingon niining paagiha nagbulag sila si Abram.
English: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

Cebuano: Si Abram didto magpuyo s a Canaan ug si Lot didto sa mga siyudad sa kapatagan. Nagkampo si Lot duol sa Sodoma.
English: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

Cebuano: Daotan kaayo ang mga tawo didto ug nagpakasala sila batok sa Ginoo. Mibalhin si Abram sa Hebron
English: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

Cebuano: Sa mibiya na si Lot ang Ginoo miingon kang Abram “Gikan sa imong nahimutangan, lantawa pag-ayo ang tanang dapit.
English: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

Cebuano: Ihatag ko kanimo ug sa imong mga kaliwat ang tanang yuta nga imong makita ug maimo na kini sa dayon.
English: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

Cebuano: Padaghanon ko ang imong mga kaliwat ug walay makaihap kanila Mas sayon pa ang pag-ihap sa abog kay sa pag-ihap unya sa imong mga kaliwat.
English: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

Cebuano: Busa pangandam ug suroya ang tibuok yuta kay ihatag ko ki ning tanan kanimo.”
English: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

Cebuano: Mibalhin si Abram ug mipuyo siya duol sa sagradong mga kahoy ni Mamre didto sa Hebron ug nagbuhat siya didto ug halaran alang sa Ginoo.
English: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

Cebuano: Si Amrafel nga hari sa Shinar si Arioc nga hari sa Elasar si Cadorlahomor nga hari sa Elam ug si Tidal nga hari sa Goyim
English: And it came to pass in the days of Am´raphel king of Shinar, Ar´i-och king of Ella´sar, Chedorla-o´mer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

Cebuano: Giulipon sila ni Cadorlahomor sulod sa 12 ka tuig apan sa ika -13 ka tuig mialsa sila batok kaniya.

English: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorla-o´mer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Reph´a-im in Ash´teroth–karna´im, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiri-atha´im,

English: And they returned, and came to En –mish´pat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amal´ekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Haz´azon–ta´mar.

Cebuano: Unya gitigom sa mga hari sa Sodoma, sa Gomora, sa Adma, sa Zeboim ug sa Bela ang ilang mga kasundalohan didto sa Walog sa Sidim ug nakiggubat sila
English: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomor´rah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboi´im, and the king of Bela,  and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

Cebuano: batok kang Cadorlahomor sa Elam kang Tidal sa Goyim kang Amrafel sa Shinar ug kang Arioc sa Elasar—lima ka hari batok sa upat.
English: with Chedorla-o´mer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Am´raphel king of Shinar, and Ar´i-och king of Ella´sar; four kings with five.

English: And the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomor´rah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

English: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomor´rah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

English: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

English: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

Cebuano: Didto gibahin niya ang iyang mga tawo sa nagkalainlaing pundok ug sa pagkagabii gisulong ug gibuntog nila ang mga hari Gigukod nila ang ilang kaaway hangtod sa Hoba, amihanan sa Damasco
English: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

Cebuano: ug nabawi nila ang tanang kabtangan Nabawi usab ni Abram ang iyang pag-umangkon nga si Lot ug ang iyang mga kabtangan lakip ang mga babaye ug ang ubang mga tawo. Gipanalanginan ni Melquisedec si Abram
English: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people. Melchizedek Blesses Abram

Cebuano: Sa pagpauli na ni Abram human niya mabuntog si Cadorlahomor ug ang kaabin niyang mga hari gitagbo siya sa hari sa Sodoma didto sa Walog sa Sabe nga gitawag usab nga Walog sa Hari.
English: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorla-o´mer and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.

Cebuano: Si Melquisedec nga hari sa Salem ug pari usab sa Labing Halangdong Dios nagdalag pan ug bino
English: And Melchiz´edek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

Cebuano: ug gipanalanginan niya si Abram sa pag-ingon: "Panalanginan ka, Abram, sa Labing Halangdong Dios nga maoy nagbuhat sa langit ug sa yuta.
English: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

Cebuano: Dalaygon ang Labing Halangdong Dios nga naghatag kanimog kadaogan batok sa imong kaaway!” Ug gihatagan siya ni Abram sa ikapulo nga bahin sa tanan nga iyang nailog.
English: and blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

Cebuano: Unya ang hari sa Sodoma miingon kang Abram, “Imo na ang tanang butang nga imong nailog apan iuli lamang kanako ang akong katawhan.”
English: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

Cebuano: Apan si Abram mitubag “Nanumpa ako sa Ginoo, ang Labing Halangdong Dios nga maoy nagbuhat sa langit ug sa yuta,
English: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

Cebuano: nga dili ako mokuha bisan unsa nga imoha bisan usa lamang ka lugas sa tanod o liston sa sandalyas Sa ingon dili ka makaingon nga nadato ako tungod kanimo.
English: that I will not take from a thread even to a shoe-latchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

Cebuano: Walay bisan unsa nga kuhaon ko alang sa akong kaugalingon Mao ray dawaton ko ang nagamit sa akong mga tawo apan hatagi sa ilang bahin ang akong kaabin nga si Aner, si Escol ug si Mamre.”
English: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

Cebuano: Human niini nakakita si Abram ug panan -awon ug nadungog niya angGinoo nga miingon kaniya "Ayaw kahadlok Abram; ako a ng imong panalipod. Hatagan ko ikawg dako kaayong ganti.”
English: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

Cebuano: Apan si Abram miingon “Ginoong Dios, wala akoy anak busa unsaon ko man kanang ganti? Ang bugtong kong manununod mao si Eliezer nga taga - Damasco.
English: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eli-e´zer of Damascus?

Cebuano: Kay wala mo man ako hatagig anak ang makapanunod sa akong kabtangan mao ang usa sa akong mga ulipon.”
English: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

Cebuano: Unya nadungog niya ang Ginoo nga miingon kaniya pag-usab, “Kining ulipona dili maoy makapanunod sa imong kabtangan kondili ang imo gayong anak.”
English: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

Cebuano: Ug gidala siya sa Ginoo ngadto sa gawas ug giingnan “Tan-awa ang langit ug ipha ang mga bituon kon makaihap ka ba Makabaton kag mga kaliwat nga sama kadaghan niana.”
English: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

Cebuano: Mituo si Abram sa Ginoo ug tungod niini giisip siyang matarong sa Ginoo.
English: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

Cebuano: Unya ang Ginoo miingon kaniya, “Ako, ang Ginoo, nagsugo kanimo pagbiya sa Ur sa Caldea aron ihatag ko kanimo kining yutaa.”
English: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

Cebuano: Apan si Abram miingon “Ginoong Dios, unsaon ko man pagkasayod nga akoa na kini?”
English: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

Cebuano: Ang Ginoo mitubag, “Dad-i akog nating baka nga baye ug kanding nga baye ug karnerong laki nga tulo ka tuig ang kagul angon ang matag usa niini Pagdala usab ug tukmo ug usa ka salampati.”
English: And he said unto him, Take me a heifer of three ye ars old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

Cebuano: Busa gidala ni Abram kining tanan ngadto sa Dios ug gipamikas niya ang mga mananap ug unya gibutang sa duha ka lumbay ang masigkapikas niini Ang mga langgam lamang ang wala niya pikasa.
English: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

Cebuano: Nanugpa sa mga pinikas nga mga mananap ang mga langgam nga manunukob ug giabog sila ni Abram.
English: And when the fowls came down upon the carcasses, Abram drove them away.

Cebuano: Sa pagsalop na sa adlaw nahikatulog ug nahinanok si Abram ug nalisang siya pag-ayo.
English: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.

English: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.

English: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

English: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked; and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
