English: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

English: And Abraham answered and sa id, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

English: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.

English: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.

Cebuano: Sa pag -abot sa duha ka anghel didto sa Sodoma nianang pagkagabii naglingkod si Lot didto sa ganghaan sa siyudad Sa pagkakita gayod niya sa duha ka tawo mitindog siya ug misugat kanila Mihapa siya sa ilang atubangan
English: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

Cebuano: ug miingon, “Ania ako aron pag-alagad kaninyo. Kon mahimo hapit kamo sa akong balay. Makapanghimasa kamo didto ug adto matulog. Ugma sa buntag makapadayon ra kamo sa inyong panaw” Apan mitubag sila “Daghang salamat na lang. Anhi ra kami matulog dinhi.”
English: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

Cebuano: Apan mipadayon gay od si Lot sa pagdapit kanila ug sa kataposan miu ban sila kaniya ngadto sa iyang balay Nagpaluto si Lot ug pan nga walay patubo ug naghikayg maayong pagkaon alang kanila ug nangaon sila.
English: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

Cebuano: Sa wala pa manghigda ang mga bisita ni Lot ang iyang balay gilibota n sa tanang mga lalaki sa Sodoma, batan-on ug tigulang.
English: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

Cebuano: Gitawag nila si Lot ug gipangutana “Hain ba ang mga lalaki nga anaa matulog sa imong balay? Dad-a sila sa gawas aron makighilawas kami kanila.”
English: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

Cebuano: Si Lot migula ug gisirhan niya ang pultahan.
English: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

Cebuano: Miingon siya kanila “Mga higala, ayaw intawon ninyo himoa ang maong mangil-ad nga buhat!
English: and said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

Cebuano: Kon gusto kamo aduna akoy duha ka anak nga dalaga Dad-on ko sila nganha kaninyo ug kamo nay mahibalo kanila Apan ayaw intawon ninyo hilabti kining mga tawhana kay mga bis ita ko sila ug kinahanglan nga panalipdan ko sila.”
English: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they und er the shadow of my roof.

Cebuano: Apan miingon sila “Ayaw pagpanghilabot sa among pagabuhaton Dili ka baya taga dinhi. Kinsa ka ba nga magbuot kon unsay among himoon? Ayaw kamig babagi aron dili ka mahiagom sa labi pang mangil -ad nga k adaot.” Unya gitulod nila si Lot ug misaka sila aron gub-on ang pultahan.
English: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

Cebuano: Apan gibira si Lot sa duha ka tawo nga didto sa sulod ug gisirh an nila ang pultahan.
English: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

Cebuano: Unya gibutaan nila ang tanang tawo didto sa gawas aron dili na sila makatultol sa pultahan. Gibiyaan Nila ni Lot ang Sodoma
English: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

Cebuano: Si Lot gipangutana sa duha ka tawo “Aduna ka bay kauban dinhi? Dad -a ang imong mga anak ug ang tanan mong mga sakop niining siyudad ug pamiya kamo dinhi
English: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

Cebuano: kay laglagon namo kining dapita Gidungog sa Ginooang makalilisang mga mulo batok sa katawhan niining siyudara ug gipadala kami niya aron paglaglag sa Sodoma.”
English: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

Cebuano: Unya giadto ni Lot ang mga pamanhonon sa iyang mga anak ug giingnan sila, “Biya kamo dayon niining dapita kay laglagon kini sa Ginoo.” Apan nagtuo sila nga nagtiaw lamang siya.
English: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons-in-law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons-in-law.

Cebuano: Sa pagkakaadlawon giapura si Lot sa mga anghel pagbiya sa siyudad Miingon sila, “Pagdali! Dad-a ang imong asawa ug ang duha mo ka anak nga dalaga ug biya kamo dinhi aron dili kamo maangin sa pagkalaglag sa siyudad.”
English: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

Cebuano: Apan naglanganlangan gihapon si Lot Busa siya ug ang iyang asawa ug duha ka anak nga dalaga gipugos pagdala sa duha ka tawo ngadto sa gawas sa siyudad. Gibuhat nila kini kay ang Ginoo naluoy man kang Lot.
English: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

Cebuano: Sa pagbiya na sa mga anghel kanila didto sa gawas sa siyudad, miingon ang usa ka anghel “Dagan kamo aron kamo maluwas! Ayaw kamo paglingi ug ayaw paghunong sa walog Dagan ngadto sa kabungtoran aron dili kamo mangamatay.”
English: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

Cebuano: Apan si Lot mitubag, “Kon mahimo dili kami moadto didto.
English: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

Cebuano: Giila ko nga dako kag gikatabang kanako. Salamat kaayo sa pagluwas mo kanako. Apan layo kaayo ang kabungtoran ug hiapsan ako sa kadaot ug mamatay ako sa dili pa makaabot didto.
English: behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

Cebuano: Busa paadtoa ako nianang gamayng lungsod sa unahan aron maluwas ako.”
English: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: O, let me escape thither,  and my soul shall live.

Cebuano: Ang anghel mitubag “Uyon ako sa imong hang yo. Dili ko iapil paglaglag kanang lungsora.
English: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

Cebuano: Hala, dagan na! Wala akoy mahimo sa dili ka pa moabot didto” Kadtong lungsora gitawag ug Zoar kay giingon man ni Lot nga gamay ra kini. Ang Pagkalaglag sa Sodoma ug sa Gomora
English: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zo´ar.

Cebuano: Sa pagsubang na sa adlaw ug nakaabot na si Lot sa Zoar,
English: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zo´ar.

Cebuano: gipaulanan sa Ginoo ug nagsigang asupre ang Sodoma ug ang Gomora.
English: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomor´rah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

Cebuano: Gilaglag sa Ginoo kining mga siyudara ug ang tibuok walog lakip ang tanang mga tawo sa mga siyudad ug ang mga tanom niadtong dapita.
English: and he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabit ants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

Cebuano: Apan ang asawa ni Lot nga nagsunod kaniya milingi ug nahimo siyang haligi nga asin.
English: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

Cebuano: Sayo sa pagkabuntag midali pag-adto si Abraham sa dapit diin nagbarog siya uban sa Ginoo.
English: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:

Cebuano: Milantaw siya sa Sodoma ug sa Gomora ug sa tibuok walog ug nakita niya ang aso nga nag-utbo, sama sa aso nga gikan sa usa ka dako kaayong hudno.
English: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomor´rah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

Cebuano: Apan sa paglaglag sa Dios sa mga siyudad sa walog wala niya hikalimti si Abraham ug gipaikyas niya si Lot sa kadaot. Ang Kagikan sa mga Moabihanon ug Amonihanon
English: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

Cebuano: Tungod kay nahadlok man si Lot pagpuyo didto sa Z oar, siya ug ang duha niya ka anak nga dalaga mibalhin ngadto sa kabungtoran diin mipuyo sila sa usa ka langub.
English: And Lot went up out of Zo´ar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zo´ar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

Cebuano: Unya ang magulang nga anak miingon sa iyang manghod “Nagkatigulang na ang atong amahan ug wala nay lalaki nga nahibilin sa tibuok kalibotan s a pagpangasawa kanato aron makabaton kitag mga anak sa naandang paagi.
English: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

Cebuano: Busa hubgon ta ang atong amahan aron makahimo kita pagpakighilawas kaniya ug makabaton ug mga anak pinaagi kaniya.”
English: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

Cebuano: Niadtong gabhiona gidalitan nila siyag bino Ug unya nakighilawas kaniya ang magulang niyang anak Apan wala siya masayod niini kay hubog man siya kaayo.
English: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, no r when she arose.

Cebuano: Pagkasunod adlaw, ang magulang niyang anak miingon na usab sa iyang manghod, “Nakighilawas ako sa at ong amahan kagabii ug karong gabii hubgon na usab nato siya ug ik aw na usab ang makighilawas kaniya aron kitang duha makabaton ug mga anak pinaagi kaniya.”
English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

Cebuano: Busa niadtong gabhiona gihubog nila siya ug nakighilawas kaniya ang manghod nga anak Apan wala gihapon siya masayod niini tungod sa iyang kahubog.
English: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

Cebuano: Sa ingon niining paagiha nagsabak ang duha ka anak ni Lot pinaagi sa ilang amahan.
English: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

Cebuano: Ang magulang nanganak ug batang lalaki nga iyang ginganlag Moab ug siya mao ang amahan sa mga Moabihanon.
English: And the firstborn bare a son, and c alled his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

Cebuano: Ang manghod nanganak usab ug batang lalaki ug ginganlan niyag Ben - ami;siya mao ang amahan sa mga Amonihanon karon.
English: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben–am´mi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

Cebuano: Mibalhin si Abraham gikan sa Mamre ngadto sa Negeb ug mipuyo siya sa tungatunga sa Cades ug Shur. Samtang nagpuyo siya sa Gerar,
English: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

Cebuano: nagpatuo siya kanila nga igsoon niya si Sara nga iyang asawa. Busa si Sara gipakuha ni Abimelec, ang hari sa Gerar.
English: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abim´elech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

Cebuano: Usa ka gabii niana mipakita ang Dios kang Abimelec pinaagi sa usa ka damgo ug miingon, “Mamatay ka kay minyo si Sara nga imong gikuha.”
English: But God came to Abim´elech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.

Cebuano: Apan wala pa makahilabot si Abimelec kang Sara ug miingon si Abimelec “Ginoo, patyon mo ba diay ako ug ang akong katawhan nga walay sala?
English: But Abim´elech had not come near her: and he said, LORD, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

Cebuano: Miingon man gud si Abraham nga si Sara iyang igsoon ug si Sara mi ingon usab nga si Abraham iyang igsoon busa gihimo ko kini ubos sa pagtuo nga dili daotan ang gibuhat ko.”
English: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

Cebuano: Mitubag ang Dios pinaagi gihapon sa damgo “Tinuod, gibuhat mo kini nga walay daotang tuyo. Busa aron dili ka makasala kanako wala ko ikaw tugoti sa paghilabot kaniya.
English: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld th ee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

Cebuano: Apan iuli karon ang babaye ngadto sa iyang bana kay ang iyang bana propeta ug iampo ka niya aron dili ka mamatay Apan kon ang babaye dili mo iuli pasidan-an ko ikaw nga mamata y ka gayod ug ang tanan mong katawhan.”
English: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

Cebuano: Busa sayo sa buntag gipatawag ni Abimelec ang tanan niyang mga sulugoon. Gisuginlan niya sila mahitungod niining mga butanga ug nangahadlok sila pag-ayo.
English: Therefore Abim´elech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

Cebuano: Unya gipaatubang ni Abimelec si Abraham ug gipangutana “Nganong gibuhat mo man kini kanamo? Unsay daotan nga akong nahimo kanimo aron ako ug ang akong gingharian dad -an mog dakong kadaot nga dili gayod angay mong buhaton kanako?
English: Then Abim´elech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

Cebuano: Nganong gibuhat mo man kini?”
English: And Abim´elech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

Cebuano: Si Abraham mitubag, “Nagtuo man gud ako nga dinhi wala gayoy nahadlok sa Dios ug nga ila akong patyon aron mailog nila ang akong asawa.
English: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

Cebuano: Ang tinuod mao nga siya akong igsoon kay anak man siya sa akong amahan apan dili sa akong inahan ug gipangasawa ko siya.
English: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

Cebuano: Busa sa pagpadala sa Dios kanako gikan sa balay sa akong amahan ngadto sa laing nasod, giingnan ko si Sara ‘Bisag asa kita ingna nga igsoon mo ako ug pinaagi niini ikapakita mo ang imong pagkamaunongon kanako.’”
English: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

Cebuano: Unya giuli ni Abimelec si Sara ngadto kang Abraham ug gihatagan usab siyag mga karnero, mga baka ug mga ulipon.
English: And Abim´elech took sheep, and oxen, and m enservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

Cebuano: Giingnan niya si Abraham, “Ania ang tibuok kong yuta, makapuyo ka dinhi bisag asa.”
English: And Abim´elech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

Cebuano: Giingnan niya si Sara, “Hatagan ko ang imong igsoon ug ka salapi nga plata. Kini maoy ilhanan alang sa tanan mong kauban nga wala ko ikaw kahilabti ug masayran sa tanan nga wala kay nabuhat nga daotan.”
English: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

Cebuano: Gihimo sa Ginoo nga dili manganak ang tanang babaye sa panimalay ni Abimelec tungod sa nahitabo kang Sara nga asawa ni Abraham. Busa nag - ampo si Abraham alang kang Abimelec ug giayo siya sa Dios Giayo usab ang iyang asawa ug ang iyang mga ulipon nga babaye aron sila manganak.
English: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abim´elech and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children. For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abim´elech, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

Cebuano: Gipanalanginan sa Ginoo si Sara sumala sa iyang gisaad
English: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

Cebuano: ug nagsabak siya ug nanganak ug batang lalaki sa dihang tigulang na si Abraham. Natawo ang bata sa adlaw nga gisaad sa Dios.
English: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

Cebuano: Ginganlan ni Abraham ang iyang anak ug Isaac.
English: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

Cebuano: Sa walo na ka adlaw ang bata gituli siya ni Abraham sum ala sa gisugo kaniya sa Dios.
English: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

Cebuano: Usa ka gatos ka tuig ang edad ni Abraham sa pagkatawo ni Isaac.
English: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

Cebuano: Miingon si Sara, “Gilipay ug gipakatawa ako sa Dios Mangatawa ang tanan uban kanako inigkasayod nila niini.”
English: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

Cebuano: Unya midugang siya sa pag-ingon, “Kay kinsay makasulti kang Abraham nga ako makapasuso pa? Apan ako nanganak ug batang lalaki bisag tigulang na si Abraham.”
English: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have borne him a son in his old age. Hagar and Ishmael Sent Away

Cebuano: Nagtubo ang bata ug sa adlaw sa paglutas niya nagkombirag dako si Abraham. Gihinginlan si Hagar ug si Ismael
English: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

Cebuano: Usa ka adlaw niana si Ismael nga an ak ni Abraham ug ni Hagar nga Ehiptohanon nagdula uban kang Isaac nga anak ni Sara.
English: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had borne unto Abraham, mocking.

Cebuano: Sapagkakita ni Sara niini giingnan niya si Abraham “Papahawaa kining ulipon nga babaye ug ang iyang anak. Kinahanglan dili mo bahinan sa imong katigayonan ang iyang anak kay ang akong anak nga si Isaac mao ray angay manunod niini.”
English: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

Cebuano: Nakapaguol kini pag -ayo kang Abraham kay si Ismael iya man usab nga anak.
English: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

Cebuano: Apan ang Dios miingon kang Abraham “Ayaw kaguol sa bata ug sa imong ulipon nga si Hagar Buhata ang giingon kanim o ni Sara kay pinaagi kang Isaac maimo ang mga kaliwat nga akong gisaad.
English: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

Cebuano: Hatagan ko usab ug daghang anak ang anak sa ulipon aron mahimo silang nasod kay siya usab imo mang anak.”
English: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

Cebuano: Sayo sa pagkabuntag gihatagan ni Abraham si Hagar ug kalan -on ug tubig nga gisulod sa panit nga sudlanan. Gipasung-ay niya ang bata kang Hagar ug iyang gipalakaw. Unya milakaw si Hagar ug naglatagaw sa kamingawan sa Berseba.
English: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba.

Cebuano: Sa nahutdan na siyag tubig, gibiyaan niya ang bata ubos sa usa ka sampinit.
English: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

Cebuano: Ug milingkod siya sa dap it nga may mga 100 ka metros ang gilay -on gikan sa bata. Miingon siya sa iyang kaugalingon “Dili ako makaako pagsud -ong nga mamatay ang bata” Unya samtang naglingkod siya didto mihilak ang bata.
English: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

Cebuano: Nadungog sa Dios ang hilak sa bata ug gikan sa langit a ng anghel sa Dios misulti kang Hagar, “Hagar, nganong naguol ka man? Ayaw kahadlok. Nabati sa Dios ang hilak sa bata.
English: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

Cebuano: Tindog, lakaw, kugosa siya ug pahiloma Himoon kong dakong nasod ang iyang mga kaliwat.”
English: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

Cebuano: Unya gipakita sa Dios kang Hagar ang usa ka a tabay. Miadto siya sa atabay ug gipuno niyag tubig ang sudlanan, ug gipainom niya ang bata.
English: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

Cebuano: Nag-uban ang Dios sa bata hangtod nga midako siya Nagpuyo siya sa kamingawan sa Paran ug nahimo siyang usa ka batid nga mangangayam.
English: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

Cebuano: Nagpili ang iyang inahan ug usa ka Ehiptohanon nga iyang pangasaw-onon. Ang Panagsabot ni Abraham ug Abimelec
English: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt. The Covenant between Abraham and Abimelech

Cebuano: Niadtong panahona si Abimelec uban ni Picol ang heneral sa iyang mga kasundalohan, miadto kang Abraham. Ug miingon siya kang Abraham “Ang Dios nagauban kanimo sa tanan nga imong gibuhat.
English: And it came to pass at that time, that Abim´elech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

Cebuano: Busa panumpa dinhi sa atubangan sa Dios nga ako o ang akong mga anak o ang akong mga kaliwat dili nimo limbongan Nagmatinud-anon ako kanimo, busa ipanumpa nga ikaw magmatinud-anon usab kanako ug niining yuta nga imong gipuy-an.”
English: now therefore swear unto me here by God, that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my so n, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

Cebuano: Miingon si Abraham, “Ipanumpa ko.”
English: And Abraham said, I will swear.

Cebuano: Si Abraham misumbong kang Abimelec bahin sa usa ka atabay nga giilog sa mga sulugoon ni Abimelec.
English: And Abraham reproved Abim´elech because of a well of water, which Abim´elech's servants had violently taken away.

Cebuano: Si Abimelec miingon, “Wala ako mahibalo kon kinsay nagbuhat niini Wala mo ako sultihi bahin niini. Karon pa ako makadungog niini.”
English: And Abim´elech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but today.

Cebuano: Unya gihatagan ni Abraham si Abimelec ug mga karnero ug mga baka ug unya naghimo silag kasabotan.
English: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abim´elech; and both of them made a covenant.

Cebuano: Mikuha si Abraham ug pito ka buok nating karnero nga baye gikan sa iyang panon.
English: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

Cebuano: Unya nangutana kaniya si Abimelec, “Nganong gihimo mo man kini?”
English: And Abim´elech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

Cebuano: Si Abraham mitubag, “Dawata kining pito ka buok nating karnero nga baye. Sa pagdawat mo niini imong gipasabot nga ako ang nagkalot niining atabaya.”
English: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

Cebuano: Ug busa gitawag ug Berseba ang maong dapit kay didto man sila magpanumpaay.
English: Wherefore he called that place Beer–sheba; because there they sware both of them.

Cebuano: Tapos mahimo nila ang kasabotan didto sa Berseba, si Abimelec ug si Picol namauli sa yuta sa mga Filistihanon.
English: Thus they made a covenant at Be er–sheba: then Abim´elech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

Cebuano: Unya nagtanom si Abraham ug kahoyng tamarisko didto sa Berseba ug iyang gisimba si Yahweh, ang walay kataposang Dios.
English: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

Cebuano: Mipuyo si Abraham didto sa yuta sa mga Filistihanon sa dugayng panahon.
English: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

Cebuano: Unya wala madugay gisulayan sa Dios si Abraham ug gitawag siya “Abraham!” Ug si Abraham mitubag, “Ania ako.”
English: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

Cebuano: Miingon ang Dios “Dad-a si Isaac ang bugtong mong anak nga imon g gihigugma ug lakaw ngadto sa yuta sa Moria. Ihalad siya pinaagi sa pagsunog kaniya didto sa bukid nga itudlo ko kanimo.”
English: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Mori´ah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

Cebuano: Busa sayo sa pagkabuntag nangahoy si Abraham alang sa halad Gisangonan niya ang iyang asno ug gipaku yog niya si Isaac ug ang duha n iya ka ulipon. Mipadulong sila sa dapit nga gisulti kaniya sa Dios.
English: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

Cebuano: Sa ikatulong adlaw sa layo pa si Abraham nakita niya ang dapit.
English: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

Cebuano: Unya giingnan niya ang iyang mga ulipon “Pabilin kamo dinhi uban sa asno. Kami si Isaac moadto didto aron pagsimba ug mob alik ra unya kami nganhi.”
English: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

Cebuano: Si Isaac maoy gipadala ni Abraham sa sugnod alang sa halad ug siya maoy nagdala sa kutsilyo ug sa kalayo. Unya mipadayon silang duha.
English: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

Cebuano: Wala madugay miingon si Isaac “Tay!” Si Abraham mitubag “Unsa man, anak?” Nangutana si Isaac, “Ania ang kalayo ug sugnod apan hain man ang ihalad nga nating karnero?”
English: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

Cebuano: Si Abraham mitubag, “Anak, ang Dios maoy mohatag kanato ug halad” Ug mipadayon sila sa paglakaw.
English: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

Cebuano: Sa pag-abot nila sa dapit nga gitudlo kaniya sa Dios gipatindog ni Abraham ang usa ka halaran ug ibabaw niini gibutang niya ang sugnod Gigapos niya ang iyang anak ug gipahiluna sa halaran ibabaw sa sugnod.
English: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

Cebuano: Unya gikuha niya ang kutsilyo aron patyon na unta niya si Isaac.
English: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

Cebuano: Apan mitawag kaniya gikan sa langit ang anghel sa Ginoo, “Abraham, Abraham!” Mitubag siya, “Ania ako.”
English: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

Cebuano: “Ayaw unsaa ang bata” miingon ang anghel “Nasayod na ako nga andam ka gayod pagsugot sa Dios kay wala mo man ihikaw kanako ang imong bugtong anak.”
English: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from me.

Cebuano: Mitan-aw si Abraham ug nakita niya ang usa ka laking kar nero kansang sungay nasangit didto sa usa ka sampinit. Gikuha niya kini ug gihalad pinaagi sa pagsunog ilis sa iyang anak.
English: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, a nd offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

Cebuano: Ginganlan ni Abraham kadtong dapita ug “Ang Ginoo maoy naghatag.” Hangtod karong mga adlawanag -ingon ang mga tawo “Didto sa bukid sa Ginoo, ang Ginoonaghatag.”
English: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah –ji´reh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

Cebuano: Gikan sa langit ang anghel sa Ginoo mitawag pag-usab kang Abraham.
English: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

Cebuano: Miingon siya, “Ang Ginoo nag-ingon, ‘Ipanumpa ko kanimo sa akong ngalan nga panalanginan ko ikaw pag -ayo kay gihimo mo man kini ug wala mo ihikaw kanako ang imong bugtong anak.
English: and said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,

Cebuano: Isaad ko usab kanimo nga hatagan ko ikawg mga kaliwat nga sama kadaghan sa bituon sa langit ug sa balas sa bayba yon. Buntogon sa imong kaliwat ang ilang mga kaaway.
English: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the seashore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

Cebuano: Ug mohangyo kanako ang tanang mga nasod nga panalanginan sila ing on nga akong gipanalanginan ang imong mga kaliwat —kay imo mang gituman ang gisugo ko kanimo.’”
English: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

Cebuano: Si Abraham mibalik sa iyang mga sulugoon ug nagkuyog sila pagpauli sa Berseba ug didto sila mopuyo. Ang mga Kaliwat ni Nahor
English: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and t hey rose up and went together to Beer–sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba.

Cebuano: Unya wala madugay nakabalita si Abraham nga nanganak si Milca ang asawa ni Nahor nga iyang igsoon.
English: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also borne children unto thy brother Nahor;

Cebuano: Si Uz ang panganay, si Buz igsoon niya, si Kemuel amahan ni Aram,
English: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kem´uel the father of Aram,

Cebuano: si Cased, si Haso, si Pildas, si Jidlaf ug si Betuel.
English: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethu´el.

Cebuano: Kini silang walo mga anak ni Milca kang Nahor nga igsoon ni Abraham.
English: And Bethu´el begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

Cebuano: Ang laing asawa ni Nahor nga si Reuma nanganak kang Teba Gaham, Tahas ug kang Maaca.
English: And his concubine, whose name was Reu´mah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Ma´achah.

Cebuano: Namatay si Sara sa 127 na ang iyang panuigon.
English: And Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

Cebuano: Didto siya mamatay sa Hebron sa yuta sa Canaan. Nagbangotan si Abraham sa pagkamatay ni Sara.
English: And Sarah died in Kir´jath–ar´ba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

Cebuano: Unya mibiya siya sa dapit diin gihaya ang iyang asawa ug giingnan niya ang mga Hitihanon,
English: And Abraham stood up fro m before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

Cebuano: “Usa ako ka langyaw nga lumalabay dinhi Baligyai akog yuta nga kalubngan ko sa akong asawa.”
English: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

Cebuano: Mitubag sila kaniya,
English: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

Cebuano: “Sir, giila ka namo nga pangulong gamhanan Ilubong ang imong asawa sa among labing maayong lubnganan Walay usa kanamo nga magdumili paghatag kanimo ug luna aron kalubngan mo kaniya.”
English: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

Cebuano: Unya mitindog si Abraham, miyukbo kanila
English: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

Cebuano: ug miingon “Kon uyon kamo nga ilubong ko dinhi ang akong asawa palihog hangyoa si Efron nga Hitihanon, anak ni Zohar
English: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

Cebuano: nga ibaligya niya kanako ang Langub sa Macpela nga iyang gipanag -iya. Anaa kini sa daplin sa iyang uma Sultihi siya sa pagbaligya niini kanako sa hustong presyo dinhi sa inyong atubangan aron maako ang yuta nga akong kalubngan.”
English: that he may give me the cave of Machpe´lah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

Cebuano: Niadtong higayona naglingkod si Efron uban sa mga Hitihanon didto sa tigomanan sa ganghaan sa lungsod. Miingon siya atubangan sa tanan,
English: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

Cebuano: “Sir, dili ko ihi kaw kanimo ang tibuok uma ug ang langub nga anaa niini Dinhi sa atubangan sa akong mga kadugo ihatag ko kini kanimo aron kalubngan sa imong asawa.”
English: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

Cebuano: Apan si Abraham miyukbo sa mga tawo
English: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

Cebuano: ug sa tingog nga nabati sa tanan giingnan niya si Efron “Kon mao kana, paliton ko ang tibuok uma Dawata ang akong ibaya d ug didto ilubong ko ang akong asawa.”
English: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

Cebuano: Mitubag si Efron,
English: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

Cebuano: “Sir, ang presyo niining yutaa ka buok salapi nga plata apan dili kana maoy mahinungdanon. Ilubong lang didto ang imong asawa.”
English: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

Cebuano: Miuyon si Abraham ug gitimbang niya ang kantidad nga gipangayo ni Efron atubangan sa mga Hitihanon — ka salapi nga plata sumala sa timbangan nga gigamit sa mga komersyante.
English: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

Cebuano: Niining paagiha naiya ni Abraham ang yuta nga kaniadto iya ni Efron didto sa Macpela silangan sa Mamre Naglakip kini sa uma sa la ngub ug sa kakahoyan sa uma hangtod sa iyang mga utlanan.
English: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpe´lah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

Cebuano: Giila kini sa mga Hitihanon nga mitambong sa tigom didto nga iya na ni Abraham.
English: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

Cebuano: Unya gilubong ni Abraham ang iyang asawa nga si Sara sa maong langub sa yuta sa Canaan.
English: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpe´lah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

Cebuano: Busa napanag-iya ni Abraham ang uma ug ang langub niini nga kaniadto ila sa mga Hitihanon.
English: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

Cebuano: Tigulang na kaayo si Abraham niining panahona ug gipanalanginan siya sa Ginoo sa tanan nga iyang gibuhat.
English: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

Cebuano: Giingnan niya ang labing tigulang niyang sulugoon nga maoy iyang gipiyalan sa tanan niyang katigayonan “Ibutang ang imong kamot sa tungatunga sa akong paa.
English: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

Cebuano: Panumpa kanako sa ngalan sa Ginoo, ang Dios sa langit ug sa yuta nga dili ka mangitag asawa nga taga dinhi sa Canaan alang sa akong anak.
English: and I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

Cebuano: Lakaw ngadto sa akong nasod ug pangitaig asawa ang akong anak nga si Isaac didto sa akong mga paryenti.”
English: but thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

Cebuano: Apan nangutana ang sulugoon, “Kon ang babaye dili mouban kanako nganhi niining yutaa paadtoon ko ba ang imong ana k ngadto sa yuta nga imong gigikanan?”
English: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

Cebuano: Mitubag si Abraham, “Ayaw gayod paadtoa didto ang akong anak.
English: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

Cebuano: AngGinoo nga Dios sa langit nagdala kanako gikan sa balay sa akong amahan ug gikan sa yuta sa akong mga paryenti Nanumpa siya kanako nga ihatag niya kin ing yutaa ngadto sa akong mga kaliwat Magpadala siyag anghel nga mag -una kanimo aron didto makakita kag asawa alang sa akong anak.
English: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

Cebuano: Apan kon ang babaye dili gustong mokuyog kanimo makalingkawas ka na niining imong panumpa kanako Bisag unsay mahitabo ayaw paadtoa didto ang akong anak.”
English: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

Cebuano: Busa gibutang sa sulugoon ang iyang kamot sa kinatawo ni Abraham nga iyang agalon ug nanumpa siya sa pagtuman sa iyang sugo.
English: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

Cebuano: Mikuha ang sulugoon ug napulo ka kamelyo sa iyang agalon ug daghang bililhong mga gasa. Giandam niya ang mga dad -onon ug mipadulong siya sa siyudad sa Nahor sa Mesopotamia.
English: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopota´mi-a, unto the city of Nahor.

Cebuano: Sa pag -abot niya iyang gipaluhod ang mga kamelyo duol sa atabay nga didto gawas sa siyudad Hapon kadto nga maoy ipangalos sa mga babaye ug tubig.
English: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

Cebuano: Unya nag -ampo siya “Ginoo, Dios sa akong agalon nga si Abraham molampos unta ako karon sa akong tuyo. Tumana ang imong gisaad sa akong agalon.
English: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.

Cebuano: Ania ako tupad sa atabay nga kalosanan ug tubig sa mga babaye sa siyudad.
English: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

Cebuano: Ingnon ko ang usa sa mga dalaga ‘Palihog, ipaubos ang imo ng tibod ug paimna ako.’ Kon moingon siya ‘Sigi, inom ug paimnon ko usab ang imong mga kamelyo,’ siya unta ang imong gipili nga maasawa sa imong sulugoon nga si Isaac. Kon mahitabo kini, akong masayran nga gituman mo ang imong gipanumpa sa akong agalon.”
English: and let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast showed kindness unto my master.

Cebuano: Wala pa gani siya makahumag ampo miabot si Rebecca nga nagpas -an ug tibod. Anak siya ni Betuel nga anak ni Milca ang asawa ni Nahor nga igsoon ni Abraham.
English: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethu´el, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

Cebuano: Ulay siya ug maanyag kaayo Milugsong siya ngadto sa atabay ug gisudlan niyag tubig ang tibod ug mipauli siya.
English: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

Cebuano: Midali pagsugat kaniya ang sulugoon ug miingon “Paimna intawon akog tubig sa imong tibod.”
English: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

Cebuano: Siya mitubag, “Sigi, inom, sir.” Ug gipaubos niya pagdali ang iyang tibod ug gikuptan niya kini samtang nag-inom siya.
English: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

Cebuano: Sa pagkahuman niyag ino m, miingon si Rebecca “Paimnon ko usab ang imong mga kamelyo kutob sa ilang gikinahanglan.”
English: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

Cebuano: Unya gidali niya pagbubo ang tubig sa iyang tibod ngadto sa pasungan sa mga mananap ug midagan siya ngadto sa atabay aron pagkalos pa ug tubig alang sa tanang kamelyo.
English: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

Cebuano: Ang tawo naniid kaniya sa hilom aron masuta niya kon gipanalanginan ba sa Ginoo ang iyang panaw.
English: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

Cebuano: Sa nakahuman na si Rebecca pagpainom sa mga kamelyo, ang tawo mikuhag singsing nga bulawan nga ka gramo ug gibutang niya kini sa ilong ni Rebecca. Mikuha usab siyag duha ka pulseras nga bulawan ug iyang gisul-ob sa mga bukton ni Rebecca.
English: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

Cebuano: Unya nangutana siya “Kinsa may imong amahan? Palihog tug-ani ako May lawak ba sa balay sa imong amahan nga kapahulayan ko ug sa akong mga kauban karong gabii?”
English: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?

Cebuano: Mitubag siya, “Anak ako ni Betuel nga anak ni Nahor ug ni Milca.
English: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethu´el the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

Cebuano: Daghang uhot ug kalan -on alang sa mga hayop didto sa among balay ug aduna kamoy kapahulayan.”
English: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

Cebuano: Unya miyukbo ang tawo ug misimba sa Ginoo
English: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.

Cebuano: ug miingon “Dalaygon ang Ginoo, ang Dios sa akong agalon nga si Abraham, kay gituman niya ang iyang gisaad ngadto sa akong agalon Gidala ako sa Ginoo sa balay gayod sa kabanay sa akong agalon.”
English: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.

Cebuano: Midagan ang batan -ong babaye ngadto sa balay sa iyang inahan ug gisugilon niya ang tanan.
English: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.

Cebuano: Si Rebecca may igsoong lalaki nga si La ban. Midagan si Laban ngadto sa tawo nga didto sa atabay.
English: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

Cebuano: Nakita niya ang singsing diha sa ilong ni Rebecca ug ang mga pulseras diha sa iyang mga bukton Nadungog usab niya si Rebecca nga nagsugilon sa gisulti kaniya sa tawo busa miadto siya sa sulugoon ni Abraham nga nagbarog tupad sa iyang mga kamelyo duol sa atabay.
English: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring, and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me, that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

Cebuano: Ug giingnan ni Laban ang sulugoon “Adto ta sa among balay Gipanalanginan ka sa Ginoo. Nganong anaa ka man lang sa gawas nga giandaman ko man ikaw ug dapit s a balay ug kabutangan sa imong kamelyo?”
English: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

Cebuano: Busa midayon ang tawo ug gidiskarga ni Laban ang mga karga sa kamelyo ug gihatagan niyag uhot ug kalan -on. Unya gidad -an niyag tubig ang sulugoon ni Abraham ug ang iyang mga kauban aron makapanghimasa sila.
English: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.

Cebuano: Sa d ihang gidulotan na silag pagkaon ang sulugoon miingon “Dili ko mokaon kon dili ko pa ikapadayag ang akong tuyo.” Si Laban miingon, “Hala, sulti na.”
English: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

Cebuano: “Sulugoon ako ni Abraham,” miingon siya,
English: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

Cebuano: “Gipanalanginan pag -ayo sa Ginoo ang akong agalon ug gihimo siyang bantogan. Gihatagan siyag mga panon sa karnero ug mga kanding, mga baka, mga salapi, mga bulawan, mga ulipong lalaki ug babaye mga kamelyo ug mga asno.
English: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly, and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

Cebuano: Sa dihang tigulang na si Sara, ang asawa sa akong agalon, nanganak siya ug batang lalaki. Gihatag sa akong agalon ang tanan niyang katigayonan ngadto sa maong anak.
English: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

Cebuano: Gipapanumpa ako sa akong agalon sa pagtuman sa iyang gisugo nga dili ko minyoon ang iyang anak sa mga babaye sa Canaan diin siya magpuyo.
English: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

Cebuano: Ug giingnan ako niya nga moadto sa katawhan sa iyang amahan ug sa iyang mga paryenti aron pagpangitag asawa alang sa iyang anak.
English: but thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

Cebuano: Ug giingnan ko ang akong agalon ‘Unsa may buhaton ko kon ang babaye dili mokuyog kanako?’
English: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

Cebuano: Siya mitubag ‘AngGinoo nga gialagaran ko kanunay magpadala sa iyang anghel uban kanimo ug mopalampos kanimo sa imong tuyo Pangitaig asawa ang akong anak didto sa mga kabanay sa akong amahan.
English: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

Cebuano: Kon buhaton mo kini, makalingkawas ka sa imong panumpa ug kon moadto ka sa akong panimalay ug mobalibad sila kanimo, makalingkawas ka usab.’
English: then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

Cebuano: “Sa pag-abot ko sa atabay karong adlawa nag-ampo ako, ‘Ginoo, Dios sa akong agalon nga si Abraham, palamposa intawon ang akong tuyo.
English: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

Cebuano: Samtang nagbarog ako duol sa atabay ang dalaga nga moanhi aron pagkalos ug tubig, ingnon ko nga paimnon akog tubig sa iyang tibod.
English: behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

Cebuano: Kon siya moingon nga hala inom ug paimnon ko usab ang imong mga kamelyo, siya na unta ang gipili sa Ginoo aron maasawa sa anak sa akong agalon.’
English: and she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.

Cebuano: Wala pa gani ako makahuman sa hilom kong pag -ampo, miabot si Rebecca nga nagpas-ag tibod ug milugsong ngadto sa atabay aron pagkalos Giingnan ko siya, ‘Paimna intawon ako.’
English: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

Cebuano: Gidali niya pagkuha ang tibod gikan sa iyang abaga ug giingnan ako ‘Sigi inom. Paimnon ko usab ang imong mga kamelyo’ Busa miinom ako ug gipainom niya ang mga kamelyo.
English: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

Cebuano: Gipangutana ko siya, ‘Kinsa may imong amahan?’ Mitubag siya ‘Anak ako ni Betuel nga anak ni Nahor ug ni Milca’ Unya gitaod ko ang singsing sa iyang ilong ug gisul-oban kog mga pulseras ang iyang mga bukton.
English: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethu´el, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

Cebuano: Miyukbo ako ug gisimba ko ug gidayeg ang Ginoo, ang Dios sa akong agalon nga si Abraham. Siya nagtultol kanako sa igsoon sa akong agalon aron ang iyang anak maasawa sa anak sa akong agalon.
English: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.

Cebuano: Karon sultihi ako kon dawaton ba ninyo ang hangyo sa akong agalon o dili ba kay ako nay mag-igo sa akong buhaton.”
English: And now, if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

Cebuano: Si Laban ug si Betuel mitubag, “Kay kining butanga gikan man sa Ginoo, dili kami maoy maghukom niini.
English: Then Laban and Bethu´el answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

Cebuano: Ania si Rebecca Dad-a siya ug lakat na Himoa siyang asawa sa anak sa imong agalon, sumala sa gisulti sa Ginoo.”
English: Behold, Rebekah is before thee; take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

Cebuano: Sa pagkadungog sa sulugo on ni Abraham niini mihapa siya sa yuta aron pagsimba sa Ginoo.
English: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.

Cebuano: Unya gihatagan niya si Rebecca ug mga alahas nga plata ug bulawan ug mga bisti. Gihatagan usab niyag mahalong mga gasa ang igsoong lalaki ug ang inahan ni Rebecca.
English: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

Cebuano: Unya nangaon ug nag -inom ang sulugoon ug an g mga kauban niya ug nangatulog sila didto Sa pagbangon nila sa pagkabuntag miingon ang sulugoon, “Mopauli na ako sa akong agalon.”
English: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

Cebuano: Apan ang inahan ug ang igsoon ni Rebecca miingon “Papuy-a unag usa ka semana o napulo ka adlaw si Rebecca uban kanamo. Unya mahimo na siyang mobiya kanamo.”
English: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abid e with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

Cebuano: Apan miingon ang sulugoon ni Abraham “Ayaw akog langana kay gipalampos sa Ginoo ang akong panaw. Tugoti nga mopauli na ako sa akong agalon.”
English: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

Cebuano: Mitubag sila, “Tawgon ta una ang babaye ug pasultihon ta siya.”
English: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.

Cebuano: Busa gitawag nila si Rebecca ug gipangutana “Buot ka bang mokuyog niining tawhana?” Siya mitubag, “Oo.”
English: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

Cebuano: Busa gipakuyog nila sa sulugoon ni Abraham ug sa iyang mga kauban si Rebecca ug ang iyang yaya.
English: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

Cebuano: Ug gipanalanginan nila si Rebecca nga nag-ingon, "Igsoon namo hinaot unta nga mahimo kang inahan sa libo ka libong kaliwat ug makabuntog sila sa mga siyudad sa ilang mga kaaway.”
English: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister; be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

Cebuano: Unya si Rebecca ug ang iyang mga sulugoong babaye misakay sa mga kamelyo aron mokuyog sa sulugoon ni Abraham.
English: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

Cebuano: Niining higayona, si Isaac nga didto magpuyo sa yuta sa Negeb nahiadto sa kamingawan sa Beerla-hai-roi.
English: And Isaac came from the way of the well La´hai –roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

Cebuano: Usa niana ka hapon misuroy siya sa kaumahan ug nakakita siyag mga kamelyo nga nagpadulong kaniya.
English: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

Cebuano: Unya nakita ni Rebecca si Isaac ug nanaog siya sa iyang kamelyo
English: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

Cebuano: ug nangutana sa sulugoon “Kinsa man kanang anaa sa uma nga nagpadulong kanato?” Ang sulugoon mitubag “Siya ang agalon ko” Busa gikuha ni Rebecca ang iyang kupo ug gitabonan niya ang iyang nawong.
English: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a veil, and covered herself.

Cebuano: Si Isaac gisuginlan sa sulugoon sa tanan nga iyang nahimo.
English: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

Cebuano: Unya gidala ni Isaac si Rebecca ngadto sa iyang tolda nga gipuy -an ni Sara nga iyang inahan ug si Rebecca gipangasawa niya Nahigugma si Isaac kang Rebecca ug si Rebecca maoy nakalipay kaniya sa pagkamatay sa iyang inahan.
English: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

Cebuano: Nangasawa si Abraham ug laing babaye nga ginganlag Ketura.
English: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Ketu´rah.

Cebuano: Nanganak si Ketura kang Zimran, Jocsan, Medan, Midian, Isbac ug Shua.
English: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Mid´i-an, and Ishbak, and Shu´ah.

Cebuano: Si Jocsan maoy amahan ni Sheba ug ni Dedan ug ang mga anak ni Dedan mao sila si Asurim, Letusim ug si Leumim.
English: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were As´shurim, and Let´ushim, and Le´ummim.

Cebuano: Ang mga anak ni Midian mao sila si Epa Eper, Hanoc, Abida ug si Eldaa Kini silang tanan mga kaliwat ni Ketura.
English: And the sons of Mid´i-an; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abi´dah, and Elda´ah. All these were the children of Ketu´rah.

Cebuano: Si Isaac maoy gipasunod ni Abraham sa iyang kabtangan.
English: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

Cebuano: Apan sa wala pa mamatay si Abraham gihatagan niyag mg a gasa ang mga anak niya sa uban niyang mga puyopuyo ug gipaadto niya sila sa silangan aron mahilayo sa iyang anak nga si Isaac. Ang Pagkamatay ni Abraham ug ang Paglubong Kaniya
English: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country. The Death and Burial of Abraham

Cebuano: Miabot si Abraham sa edad nga
English: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.

Cebuano: Namatay siya nga tigulang na kaayo ug natipon ngadto sa iyang katawhan.
English: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

Cebuano: Gilubong siya ni Isaac ug ni Ismael didto sa langub sa Macpela sa uma ni Efron nga anak ni Zohar nga Hitihanon, sa silangan sa Mamre.
English: And his sons Isaac and Ish´ma-el buried him in the cave of Machpe´lah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

Cebuano: Ang maong uma napalit ni Abraham gikan sa mga Hitihanon Didto gilubong si Abraham sa gilubngan sa iyang asawa nga si Sara.
English: the fie ld which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

Cebuano: Sa namatay na si Abraham gipanalanginan sa Dios si Isaac nga didto magpuyo duol sa atabay sa Beerla-hai-roi. Ang mga Kaliwat ni Ismael
English: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well La´hai–roi. The Descendants of Ishmael

Cebuano: Mao kini ang mga kaliwat ni Ismael ang anak ni Abraham kang Agar nga Ehiptohanon nga ulipon ni Sara.
English: Now these are the generations of Ish´ma-el, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

Cebuano: Ang mga ngalan nila gikan sa kamagulangan ngadto sa kamanghoran mao kining mosunod: Nebaiot, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
English: and these are the names of the sons of Ish´ma-el, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ish´ma-el, Neba´joth; and Kedar, and Ad´beel, and Mibsam,

Cebuano: Misma, Duma, Masa,
English: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

Cebuano: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Napis ug si Kedema.
English: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Ked´emah:

Cebuano: Mao kini ang mga anak nga lalak i ni Ismael ug ang ilang mga ngalan mao ang ngalan sa ilang mga balangay ug mga kampohanan —12 sila ka pangulo, usa sa matag tribo.
English: these are the sons of Ish´ma-el, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

Cebuano: Ang edad ni Ismael 137 dihang namatay siya ug gilubong siya tipon sa iyang katawhan.
English: And these are the years of the life of Ish´ma-el, a hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died, and was gathered unto his people.

Cebuano: Nagpuyo ang mga kaliwat ni Ismael sa tungatunga sa Habila ug sa Shur sa silangan sa Ehipto paingon sa Asiria Milain sila pagpuyo sa tanan nilang kaparyentihan. Natawo si Esau ug si Jacob
English: And they dwelt from Hav´ilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren. The Birth of Esau and Jacob

Cebuano: Mao kini ang sugilanon mahitungod ni Isaac nga anak ni Abraham.
English: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

Cebuano: Si Isaac nag -edad na ug 40 sa dihan g nangasawa siya kang Rebecca nga anak ni Betuel nga taga-Aramea sa Mesopotamia. Si Rebecca igsoon ni Laban nga taga-Aramea usab.
English: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethu´el the Syrian of Pa´dan–a´ram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

Cebuano: Wala manganak ang asawa ni Isaac Busa nag -ampo siya sa Ginoo. Gidungog sa Ginoo ang iyang pag-ampo ug nagmabdos si Rebecca.
English: And Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

Cebuano: Sa nagdinut-anay na ang kaluha sulod sa iyang tiyan miingon si Rebecca “Nganong ingon man niini ang nahitabo kanako?” Ug nag -ampo siya sa Ginoo aron pagpakisayod kon unsay angay niyang buhaton.
English: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to inquire of the LORD.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Ginoo kaniya, "Duha ka nasod ang anaa sa imong tiyan. Manganak ka ug duha ka katawhan nga magkontrahay Ang usa mahimong mas gamhanan kay sa usa, ang magulang mahimong sulugoon sa manghod.”
English: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

Cebuano: Nanganak si Rebecca ug kaluhang lalaki.
English: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

Cebuano: Ang unang gianak may pagkapula ug pamanit ug balhiboon busa ginganlan nila siyag Esau.
English: And the first came out red, all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

Cebuano: Sa pagkatawo na sa iyang kaluha nagkupot siya sa tikod ni Esau busa ginganlan siyag Jacob. Nag-edad na ug 60 si Isaac sa dihang nangatawo sila. Gibaligya ni Esau ang Iyang mga Katungod sa Pagkamagulang
English: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them. Esau Sells His Birthright

Cebuano: Sa dagko na ang mga ba ta, nahimong batid nga mangangayam si Esau Gusto siyang magsuroysuroy sa kapatagan samtang si Jacob hilomon ug gusto nga anha ra sa balay.
English: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

Cebuano: Pinangga ni Isaac si Esau kay gusto man siyang mokaon sa mga inayaman ni Esau apan si Jacob maoy pinangga ni Rebecca.
English: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

Cebuano: Usa niana ka adlaw samtang naglata si Jacob ug mga liso nahiuli si Esau gikan nga nangayam sa kapatagan.
English: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

Cebuano: Gigutom siya ug miingon kang Jacob “Pakan-a ako nianang imong sabawng pula kay gigutom ako.”
English: and Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

Cebuano: Apan si Jacob mitubag, “Pakan-on ko ikaw niini kon ihatag mo kanako ang imong mga katungod sa pagkamagulang.”
English: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

Cebuano: Miingon si Esau, “Oo, ihatag ko! Unsa may kapu slanan sa akong katungod sa pagkamagulang kon mamatay ako karon sa kagutom?”
English: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

Cebuano: Si Jacob mitubag, “Panumpa una nga ihatag mo gayod kanako ang imong mga katungod.” Busa nanumpa si Esau ug iyang gibaligya kang Jacob ang iyang mga katungod sa pagkamagulang.
English: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

Cebuano: Unya gihatagan siya ni Jacob ug pipila ka buok pan ug linat -ang mga liso. Ug gikaon niya kini unya miinom ug milakaw Sa ingon niining paagiha gipakawalay bili niya ang iyang mga katungod sa pagkamagulang.
English: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.

Cebuano: May lain na usab nga gutom nga miabot niadtong dapita gawas niadtong gutom sa panahon ni Abraham Miadto si Isaac kang Abimelec ang hari sa mga Filistihanon didto sa Gerar.
English: And there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abim´elech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

Cebuano: Unya ang Ginoo mipakita kang Isaac ug miingon, “Ayaw pag-adto sa Ehipto. Puyo sa dapit nga itudlo ko kanimo.
English: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of.

Cebuano: Pabilin sa maong dapit kay ihatag ko kining yutaa kanimo ug sa imong mga kaliwat. Magauban ako kanimo ug panalanginan ko ikaw Tumanon ko ang akong gisaad sa imong amahan nga si Abraham.
English: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

Cebuano: Padaghanon ko ang imong mga kaliwat sama kadaghan sa mga bituon sa langit ug ihatag ko kanila kining yutaa Mangaliyupo unya ang tanang kanasoran sa kalibotan nga panalanginan ko sila sama sa pagpanalangin ko sa imong mga kaliwat
English: and I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed:

Cebuano: kay nagtuman man si Abraham sa tanan kong gisugo kaniya.”
English: because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

Cebuano: Busa mipuyo si Isaac sa Gerar.
English: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar.

Cebuano: Unya sa dihang gipangutana siya sa mga lalaking molupyo sa maong dapit bahin sa iyang asawa, mitubag siya, “Igsoon ko siya” Gihimo niya kini kay nahadlok man siya nga patyon tungod kang Rebecca kay guwapa man siya kaayo.
English: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

Cebuano: Unya sa dugaydugay na si Isaac didto nakita ni Abimelec gikan sa bintana sa iyang palasyo nga naggakosgakos si Isaac ug si Rebecca.
English: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abim´elech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

Cebuano: Busa gipatawag ni Abimelec si Isaac ug giingnan, “Sa walay duhaduha asawa mo siya! Apa n nganong miingon ka man nga igsoon mo siya?” Si Isaac mitubag, “Nahadlok ako nga patyon ako sa mga tawo kon motug -an ako nga siya akong asawa.”
English: And Abim´elech called Isaac, and said, B ehold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

Cebuano: Miingon si Abimelec “Nganong gibuhat mo man kini kanamo? Kon gihilabtan pa sa usa sa akong mga sakop ang imong asawa makasala unta kami tungod kanimo!”
English: And Abim´elech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lain with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

Cebuano: Unya gimandoan ni Abimelec ang tanang tawo nga dili nila pasipad -an si Isaac ug si Rebecca. Patyon ang magpasipala kanila.
English: And Abim´elech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

Cebuano: Unya nag-uma si Isaac sa maong dapit ug niadtong tuiga usa ka gatos ka pilo ang iyang naani sa iyang pinugas kay gipanalanginan man siya sa Ginoo.
English: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year a hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

Cebuano: Nagpadayon siya sa pag-uswag hangtod nadato siya pag-ayo.
English: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

Cebuano: Gikasinahan siya sa mga Filistihanon tungod kay daghan man siyag mga karnero ug mga baka. Daghan usab siyag mga ulipon.
English: for he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

Cebuano: Busa gitabonan nilag yuta ang mga atabay nga kinalot sa mga sulugoon sa iyang amahan nga si Abraham sa buhi pa siya.
English: For all the wells which his fathe r's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

Cebuano: Unya miingon si Abimelec kang Isaac “Pahawa dinhi kay mas gamhanan pa man kamo kay kanamo.”
English: And Abim´elech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

Cebuano: Busa mibiya si Isaac ug didto na magpuyo sa Walog sa Gerar.
English: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

Cebuano: Gipakalot niya pag -usab ang mga atabay nga gikalot kaniadto sa mga sulugoon sa iyang amahan nga si Abraham apan gitabonan sa mga Filistihanon sa pagkamatay na ni Abraham. Ug ginganlan ni Isaac ang maong mga atabay sa mao gihapong mga ngalan nga gingalan ni Abraham niini.
English: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

Cebuano: Nagkalot ug atabay ang mga sulugoon ni Isaac didto sa walog ug nakakita silag tubod.
English: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

Cebuano: Unya giaway sa mga bakero nga taga-Gerar ang mga bakero ni Isaac kay ila man kuno ang tubod Busa ginganlag Esekni Isaac ang maong atabay kay giaway man siya sa taga-Gerar.
English: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

Cebuano: Unya nagkalot na usab ug laing atabay ang mga sulugoon ni Isaac ug giaway na usab sila busa ginganlan ni Isaac ug Sitna ang maong atabay.
English: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

Cebuano: Unya mibalhin siya sa laing dapit ug nagkalot didto ug laing atabay ug wala na siya samoka busa ginganlan niya kinig Rehobot Miingon siya “Karon, gihatagan na gayod kita sa Ginoo ug kagawasan dinhi niining yutaa ug magmauswagon gayod kita dinhi.”
English: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Reho´both; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

Cebuano: Unya mibalhin si Isaac ngadto sa Berseba.
English: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba.

Cebuano: Ug niadtong gabhiona mipakita ang Ginoo kaniya ug miingon “Ako ang Dios ni Abraham nga imong amahan Ayaw kahadlok kay ako nag -uban kanimo. Panalanginan ko ikaw ug padaghanon ko ang imong k aliwat tungod sa akong sulugoon nga si Abraham.”
English: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

Cebuano: Ug naghimo si Isaac ug halaran didto ug gisimba niya ang Ginoo. Didto nagkampo siya ug gipakalot niyag atabay ang iyang mga sulugoon. Ang Kasabotan ni Isaac ug ni Abimelec
English: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

Cebuano: Unya gikan sa Gerar si Abimelec nakigkita kang Isaac. Kauban ni Abimelec ang iyang magtatambag nga si Ahuza ug ang heneral sa iyang kasundalohan nga si Picol.
English: Then Abim´elech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuz´zath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

Cebuano: Nangutana si Isaac kanila “Nganong nakigkita man kamo kanako nga kaniadto kaaway man ako ninyo ug gihinginlan man gani ako ninyo?”
English: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

Cebuano: Ug mitubag sila “Karon nasayod na kami nga nag -uban ang Dios kanimo Busa nakahunahuna kami sa paghimog pinanumpaang kasabotan uban kanimo. Buot kami nga mosaad ka
English: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

Cebuano: nga dili mo kami samukon ingon nga wala kami magsamok kanimo Maayo kami kanimo ug wala ka namo hilabti sa pagbiya mo Karon gipanalanginan ka sa Dios.”
English: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.

Cebuano: Unya naghimog kombira si Isaac alang kanila ug nangaon sila ug nanginom.
English: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

Cebuano: Sayo sa buntag nagsinaaray sila inubanag panumpa Unya gipagikan sila ni Isaac ug namauli sila nga may pakigdait.
English: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

Cebuano: Niadtong adlawa miadto kaniya ang iyang mga sulugoon aron pagsugilon nga ang atabay nga ilang gikalot may tubig na.
English: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

Cebuano: Ginganlan ni Isaac ang maong atabay ug Seba Tungod niini ang siyudad ginganlan ug Berseba hangtod karon. Ang Langyaw nga mga Asawa ni Esau
English: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer–sheba unto this day.

Cebuano: Nag-edad ug 40 ka tuig si Esau sa dihang nangasawa siya kang Judit nga anak ni Beeri nga Hitihanon. Nangasawa usab siya kang Basimat nga anak ni Elon nga Hitihanon usab.
English: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Be-e´ri the Hittite, and Bash´emath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

Cebuano: Ang mga asawa ni Esau nakapasubo pag-ayo kang Isaac ug kang Rebecca.
English: which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

Cebuano: Tigulang na si Isaac ug dili na makakita Gipatawag niya si Esau ang magulang niyang anak, ug giingnan, “Anak!” Ug mitubag si Esau, “Unsa man, Tay?”
English: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

Cebuano: Miingon si Isaac, “Tigulang na ako ug sa dili madugay mamatay na.
English: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

Cebuano: Busa kuhaa ang imong mga hinagiban ang imong pana ug udyong Lakaw ug pangayam.
English: now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

Cebuano: Unya lutoi ako sa kinaham kong putahi ug dad -a nganhi kay akong kan-on. Ug panalanginan ko ikaw sa dili pa ako mamatay.”
English: and make me savory meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

Cebuano: Nagpaminaw si Rebecca sa gisulti ni Isaac kang Esau. Busa sa nakalakaw na si Esau aron mangayam,
English: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

Cebuano: giingnan ni Rebecca si Jacob “Nakadungog ako sa imong amahan nga miingon kang Esau,
English: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

Cebuano: ‘Pangayam ug lutoi akog lamiang sud -an kay kan -on ko kini ug unya panalanginan ko ikaw sa atubangan sa Ginoo sa dili pa ako mamatay.’
English: Bring me venison, and make me savory meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

Cebuano: Busa, anak, buhata dayon kining isugo ko kanimo.
English: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

Cebuano: Lakaw ngadto sa toril ug pagpilig duha ka nating kanding nga tambok aron magluto ako sa kinaham nga sud-an sa imong amahan.
English: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savory meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

Cebuano: Unya idulot kini sa imong amahan aron panalanginan ka niya sa dili pa siya mamatay.”
English: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

Cebuano: Apan si Jacob miingon sa iyang inahan, “Balhiboon man si Esau ug ako dili.
