English: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

Cebuano: Tingalig hikapon ako sa akong amahan ug masayran niya nga gitunto ko siya. Busa imbis panalanginan niya ako, tunglohon hinuon.”
English: my father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

Cebuano: Ug mitubag ang iyang inah an, “Kon tunglohon ka, anak, akoy modawat sa tunglo. Buhata lamang ang gisugo ko kanimo.”
English: And his mother said unt o him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

Cebuano: Busa nagkuha si Jacob ug duha ka buok kanding ug gidala niya kini kang Rebecca, ug giluto ni Rebecca ang kinaham nga sud-an ni Isaac.
English: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savory meat, such as his father loved.

Cebuano: Unya gikuha ni Rebecca ang l abing maayong sapot ni Esau nga iyang gitipigan sa balay ug gisul-ob niya kini kang Jacob.
English: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

Cebuano: Ug gibutangan niya sa panit sa kanding ang mga bukton ug ang hamis nga bahin sa liog ni Jacob.
English: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

Cebuano: Unya gihatag niya kang Jacob ang lamiang sud-an ug pan nga iyang giluto.
English: and she gave the savory meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

Cebuano: Unya miadto si Jacob sa iyang amahan ug miingon “Ania na ako, Amahan ko.” Ug miingon si Isaac, “Kinsa ka man, anak?”
English: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

Cebuano: Mitubag si Jacob, “Ako si Esau, ang imong kamagulangang anak. Natuman ko na ang gisugo mo kanako. Busa bangon na ug kaon niining dala kong sud- an aron unya panalanginan mo ako.”
English: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

Cebuano: Si Isaac miingon “Pagkadali ba nimong nakakuha anak!” Ug mitubag si Jacob, “Mitabang man gud kanako ang Ginoo nga imong Dios.”
English: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.

Cebuano: Miingon si Isaac kang Jacob “Duol ngari aron mahikap ko ikaw ug masiguro ko nga ikaw gayod si Esau.”
English: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

Cebuano: Busa miduol si Jacob ug gihikap siya ni Isaac nga miingon “Morag kang Jacob ang imong tingog apan ang imong mga bukton morag kang Esau.”
English: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

Cebuano: Wala makaila si Isaac kang Jacob kay balhiboon man ang iyang bukton sama sa kang Esau. Iya na untang panalanginan si Jacob
English: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

Cebuano: apan nangutana na usab siya, “Ikaw ba gayod ang akong anak nga si Esau?” "Oo,” mitubag si Jacob.
English: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

Cebuano: Miingon si Isaac “Hatagi ako sa linuto mong sud -an kay mokaon ako ug unya panalanginan ko ikaw” Busa gidala ni Jac ob sa iyang amahan ang pagkaon ingon man ang bino.
English: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

Cebuano: Unya miingon si Isaac, “Duol pag-ayo kanako, anak, ug hagki ako.”
English: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

Cebuano: Sa pagduol ni Jacob aron paghalok kaniya gisimhot ni Isaac ang sapot ni Jacob ug gipanalanginan niya si Jacob Miingon siya "Ang baho sa akong anak sama sa baho sa uma nga gipanalanginan sa Ginoo.
English: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

Cebuano: Hatagan ka unta sa Dios ug yamog gikan sa langit ug himoon unta niyang tambok ang imong kaumahan Hatagan ka unta niya ug daghang abot nga trigo ug bino.
English: therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

Cebuano: Mahimo untang sulugoon nimo ang mga kanasoran ug moyukbo unta kanimo ang mga katawhan. Mahimo ka untang agalon sa imong mga paryenti ug moyukbo usab unta kanimo ang mga kaliwat sa imong inahan Tunglohon unta ang magtunglo kanimo ug panalanginan unta ang manalangin kanimo.” Nangaliyupo si Esau sa Panalangin ni Isaac
English: let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

Cebuano: Human ihatag ni Isaac ang iyang panalangin, milakaw si Jacob ug mao usay pag-abot ni Esau gikan nga nangayam.
English: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

Cebuano: Nagluto usab siyag lamian nga sud -an ug gidala niya kini ngadto sa iyang amahan. Miingon siya, “Tay, bangon ug kan-a kining sud-an nga giandam ko alang kanimo aron panalanginan mo ako.”
English: And he also had made savory meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

Cebuano: Nangutana si Isaac kang Esau “Kinsa ka man?” Si Esau mitubag “Ako si Esau, ang imong anak nga magulang.”
English: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn, Esau.

Cebuano: Nangurog ang tibuok lawas ni Isaac ug nangutana siya “Kinsa man diay kadtong nangayam ug midalit kanakog sud -an ganiha? Bag-o pa lang akong nakakaon sa pag-abot mo. Gikahatag ko na kaniya ang akong panalangin ug dili na gayod kini mabakwi.”
English: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

Cebuano: Pagkadungog ni Esau niini, mihilak siyag kusog ug midanguyngoy nga nag- ingon. “Tay, panalangini usab intawon ako!”
English: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

Cebuano: Si Isaac mitubag “Mianhi ang imong igsoon ug gilimbongan niya ako Giilog niya ang imong panalangin.”
English: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

Cebuano: Miingon si Esau, “Ikaduha na kining higayon nga gitikasan niya ako. Angay gayod diay siyang nganlag Jacob Giilog niya a ng mga katungod ko sa pagkamagulang ug karon iya na usab nga giilog kanako ang akong panalangin. Wala ka na ba diay panalangin nga nahibilin alang kanako?”
English: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he h ath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

Cebuano: Si Isaac mitubag kang Esau “Gihimo ko na siya nga imong agalon ug gihimo ko usab ang tanan niyang paryenti nga iyang mga sulugoon Gikahatag ko na kaniya ang trigo ug bino Busa unsa pa may mahimo ko kanimo, anak?”
English: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

Cebuano: Apan nagpakiluoy si Esau sa iyang amahan ug miingon “Tay, mao ra ba kadtoy imong panalangin? Intawon panalangini usab ako” Unya mihila k siyag kusog.
English: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

Cebuano: Ug si Isaac miingon kaniya "Dili gayod motambok ang imong yuta o makadawat ug ulan gikan sa langit ang imong kaumahan.
English: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

Cebuano: Mabuhi ka pinaagi sa imong espada ug maulipon ka sa imong igsoon. Apan inigsukol nimo, makalingkawas ka sa iyang gahom.”
English: and by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother: and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck. Jacob Flees from Esau

Cebuano: Gikasilagan ni Esau si Jacob kay ang iyang panalangin gikahatag man sa ilang amahan ngadto kang Jacob Miingon siya sa iyang kaugalingon “Hapit na mamatay ang akong amahan Inigkamatay niya patyon ko gayod si Jacob.”
English: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

Cebuano: Apan nakabalita si Rebecca sa bahad ni Esau busa gipatawag niya si Jacob ug giingnan niya “Nagplano ang imong igsoon nga manimalos kanimo ug patyon ka niya.
English: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

Cebuano: Busa, anak, pangandam ug kagiw ngadto sa akong igsoon nga si Laban nga atua magpuyo sa Haran.
English: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

Cebuano: Pabilin didto hangtod nga mohuwas ang kasuko sa imong igsoon
English: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

Cebuano: ug malimtan na niya ang imong gibuhat kaniya Ipakuha ko lang ikaw unya. Nganong magdungan man kamog pangawala kanako?” Gipakagiw ni Isaac si Jacob ngadto kang Laban
English: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

Cebuano: Miingon si Rebecca kang Isaac “Gilaayan na ako ug dili na makaantos sa mga langyaw nga asawa ni Esau. Kon mangasawa usab si Jacob sa usa niining mga Hitihanon, maayo pa nga mamatay na lang ako.”
English: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

Cebuano: Gipatawag ni Isaac si Jacob ug gipanalanginan niya ug giingnan “Ayaw gayod pangasawag taga-Canaan.
English: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

Cebuano: Pangandam ug lakaw ngadto sa Mesopotamia sa pinuy-anan ni Betuel ang amahan sa imong inahan Didto pangasawa ug maoy pangasaw -a ang usa sa mga anak sa imong uyoan nga si Laban.
English: Arise, go to Pa´dan–a´ram, to the house of Bethu´el thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

Cebuano: Panalanginan unta sa Dios nga Labing Gamhanan ang inyong kaminyoon ug hatagan kag daghang mga anak aron mahimo kang amaha n sa daghang kanasoran.
English: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

Cebuano: Panalanginan ka unta niya ug ang imong mga kaliwat ingon nga gipanalanginan niya si Abraham Maimo unta kining yutaa nga gipuy -an nimo nga gihatag sa Dios kang Abraham.”
English: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land w herein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

Cebuano: Unya gipalakaw ni Isaac si Jacob ngadto kang Laban didto sa Mesopotamia Si Laban anak ni Betuel nga taga -Aramea. Igsoon ni Laban si Rebecca nga inahan ni Jacob ug ni Esau. Si Esau Nangasawa na Usab
English: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Pa´dan –a´ram unto Laban, son of Bethu´el the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

Cebuano: Nakabalita si Esau nga gipanalanginan ni Isaac si Jacob ug gipaadto sa Mesopotamia aron mangasawa didto Nakabalita usab siya nga sa pagpanalangin ni Isaac kang Jacob, gipasidan-an niya si Jacob nga dili gayod mangasawag taga-Canaan.
English: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Pa´dan– a´ram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

Cebuano: Nasayran usab niya nga gituman ni Jacob ang giingon sa iyang amahan ug inahan busa mipaingon siya sa Mesopotamia.
English: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Pa´dan– a´ram;

Cebuano: Nasabtan ni Esau nga ang iyang amahan dili gusto sa mga babaye nga taga - Canaan.
English: and Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

Cebuano: Busa miadto siya kang Ismael nga anak ni Abraham ug gipangasawa niya dugang sa iyang mga asawa si Mahalat nga igsoon ni Nebaiot anak ni Ismael. Ang Damgo ni Jacob didto sa Betel
English: then went Esau unto Ish´ma-el, and took unto the wives which he had Ma´halath the daughter of Ish´ma-el Abraham's son, the sister of Neba´joth, to be his wife. God Appears to Jacob at Beth–el

Cebuano: Mibiya si Jacob sa Berseba ug mipaingon sa Haran.
English: And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba, and went toward Haran.

Cebuano: Nahiabot siya sa usa ka dapit ug mipahulay siya didto kay gabii na man Mihigda siya aron matulog ug bato ang iyang giunlan.
English: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

Cebuano: Unya nagdamgo siya. Sa iyang damgo nakita niya a ng usa ka hagdan nga misangko sa langit. Sa maong hagdan may mga anghel sa Dios nga nagsaka - kanaog.
English: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

Cebuano: Nakita usab niya ang Ginoo nga nagbarog tupad kaniya ug miingon, “Ako angGinoo, ang Dios ni Abraham ug ni Isaac Ihatag ko ka nimo ug sa imong mga kaliwat kining yuta nga imong gihigdaan.
English: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

Cebuano: Modaghan ang imong mga kaliwat sama kadaghan sa abog sa yuta Mokaylap sila ngadto sa kasadpan ug sa silangan sa amihanan ug sa habagatan. Ug ang tanang katawhan sa kalibotan mohangyo kanako nga panalanginan ko sila sama sa pagpanalangin ko kanimo ug sa imong mga kaliwat.
English: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth; and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

Cebuano: Timan-i nga ako nag -uban kanimo Panalipdan ko ikaw bisag asa ka paingon ug dad -on ko ikaw pagbalik niining yutaa Dili ko ikaw biyaan hangtod nga matuman ang gisaad ko kanimo.”
English: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

Cebuano: Unya nahigmata si Jac ob ug miingon siya “Wala ko hibaloi nga ania diay ang Ginoo niining dapita!”
English: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

Cebuano: Nahadlok siya ug miingon “Pagkabalaan diay niining dapita! Kini gayod ang gipuy-an sa Dios ug ang ganghaan sa langit.”
English: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

Cebuano: Sa pagkabuntag, sayo nga mibangon si Jacob Gikuha niy a ang bato nga iyang giunlanan ug iya kining giugbok silbing handomanan Unya gibuboan niya kinig lana.
English: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

Cebuano: Ginganlan niyag Betel ang maong dapit
English: And he called the name of that place Beth–el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

Cebuano: Unya naghimog panaad si Jacob ngadto sa Ginoo. Siya miingon “Kon ubanan mo ako ug bantayan sa akong pagpanaw ug hatagan mo akog bisti ug pagkaon
English: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

Cebuano: ug kon mahiuli ako sa balay sa akong amahan nga walay kadaot nga mahitabo kanako, ilhon ko ikaw nga akong Dios.
English: so that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

Cebuano: Ug kining bato nga akong giugbok silbing handomanan mahimon g imong balay ug ihatag ko kanimo ang ikapulo sa tanang ihatag mo kanako.”
English: and this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

Cebuano: Mipadayon si Jacob sa iyang panaw ug mipaingon siya sa yuta sa katawhan sa silangan.
English: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

Cebuano: Unya nakita niya ang usa ka atabay didto sa ka umahan ug duol sa maong atabay may tulo ka pundok sa mga karnero nga naglubog Ang tubig nga gipainom sa mga karnero gikan sa maong atabay nga gitabonan ug dakong bato.
English: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.

Cebuano: Inigkapundok na sa tanang karnero didto ligiron sa mga magbalantay sa karnero ang bat ong gitabon ug paimnon nila ang mga karnero Unya ibalik nila pagtabon ang bato.
English: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.

Cebuano: Gipangutana ni Jacob ang mga magbalantay sa karnero kon taga diin sila ug mitubag sila, “Taga-Haran kami.”
English: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

Cebuano: “Nakaila ba kamo kang Laban nga anak ni Nahor?” nangutana pag -usab si Jacob. "Oo,” mitubag sila.
English: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

Cebuano: Ug nangutana pa gayod si Jacob kon maayo bag panglawas si Laban ug mitubag usab sila “Maayo man Tan-awa, ania paingon nganhi ang iyang anak nga babaye nga si Raquel uban sa mga karnero sa iyang amahan.”
English: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

Cebuano: Miingon si Jacob, “Taas pa ang adlaw ug dili pa panahon nga tigumon ninyo dinhi ang mga hay op. Nganong dili man hinuon ninyo sila paimnon ug pasibsibon?”
English: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

Cebuano: Mitubag sila “Dili kami makahimo niana hangtod nga matigom na ang tanang karnero ug maligid na ang bato.”
English: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

Cebuano: Samtang nakigsulti pa si Jacob kanila miabot si Raquel uban sa mga karnero sa iyang amahan kay siya may nag-atiman sa kahayopan sa iyang amahan.
English: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.

Cebuano: Sa pagkakita ni Jacob kang Raquel uban sa mga karnero ni Laban nga iyang uyoan, miadto siya sa atabay ug giligid niya an g batong gitabon niini ug gipainom niya ang mga karnero.
English: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

Cebuano: Unya gihagkan niya si Raquel ug mihilak si Jacob sa kalipay.
English: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

Cebuano: Miingon siya, “Anak ako ni Rebecca ug pag -umangkon sa imong amahan” Midagan si Raquel pauli sa ila aron ibalita kini sa iyang amahan.
English: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

Cebuano: Sa pagkadungog gayod ni Laban sa balita mahitungod sa iyang pag- umangkon nga si Jacob midagan siya aron pagtagbo kang Jacob Gigakos niya si Jacob ug gihagkan ug unya gidala niya ngadto sa ila Unya gisugilon ni Jacob kang Laban ang tanang nahitabo.
English: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

Cebuano: Si Laban miingon “Tinuod gayod nga ikaw akong kadugo” Mipuyo si Jacob didto ug usa ka bulan. Nangalagad si Jacob kang Laban alang kang Lea ug Raquel
English: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and m y flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

Cebuano: Miingon si Laban kang Jacob “Dili maayo nga moalagad ka kanako nga walay suholsuhol tungod lamang kay paryenti kita Pila bay gusto mong suhol?”
English: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

Cebuano: Si Laban may duha ka anak nga dalaga. Lea ang ngalan sa magulang ug ang manghod ginganlag Raquel.
English: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Le´ah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

Cebuano: Nindot ug mga mata si Lea apan si Raquel nindot kaayog lawas ug guwapa pa gayod.
English: Le´ah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well-favored.

Cebuano: Nahigugma si Jacob kang Raquel busa miingon siya, “Moalagad ako kanimo ug pito ka tuig alang sa imong anak nga manghod nga si Raquel.”
English: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

Cebuano: Miingon si Laban “Mas maayo pa nga ihatag ko siya kanimo kay sa laing tawo. Busa puyo dinhi tipon kanako.”
English: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

Cebuano: Mialagad si Jacob ug pito ka tuig aro n maiya si Raquel ug ang maong gidugayon daw pipila lamang ka adlaw alang kaniya kay gihigugma man niya si Raquel.
English: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

Cebuano: Unya miingon si Jacob kang Laban “Natapos na ang tagal Busa ihatag na kanako si Raquel aron maasawa ko na siya.”
English: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

Cebuano: Busa naghimog kombira si Laban ug gidapit niya ang tanang molupyo niadtong dapita.
English: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

Cebuano: Apan nianang pagkagabii, si Lea maoy gidala ni Laban ngadto kang Jacob dili si Raquel, ug gipadulog kaniya.
English: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Le´ah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

Cebuano: Gihatag usab ni Laban ang iyang ulipong babaye nga si Zilfa ngadto kang Lea ingon nga iyang sulugoon.
English: And Laban gave unto his daughter Le´ah Zilpah his maid for a handmaid.

Cebuano: Sa pagkabuntag nakita ni Jacob nga si Lea diay ang midulog kaniya Busa giingnan niya si Laban, “Nganong gibuhat mo man kini kanako? Dili ba nag - alagad man ako kanimo alang kang Raquel? Nganong gilimbongan mo man ako?”
English: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Le´ah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

Cebuano: Si Laban mitubag, “Dili namo batasan nga ang manghod mouna pagminyo sa magulang.
English: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

Cebuano: Hulata hangtod nga mahuman kining usa ka semana ng pagsaulog sa kasal ug unya ihatag ko kanimo si Raquel kon moalagad ka kanakog laing pito ka tuig.”
English: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

Cebuano: Miuyon si Jacob ug sa pagkatapos sa usa ka semana gihatag ni Laban si Raquel kang Jacob aron maasawa niya.
English: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

Cebuano: Ug gihatag ni Laban kang Raquel ang iyang ulipong babaye nga si Bilha ingon nga iyang sulugoon.
English: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

Cebuano: Nakigdulog usab si Jacob kang Raquel ug gihigugma niya si Raquel labaw kang Lea. Mialagad siya kang Laban ug laing pito ka tuig. Ang mga Anak ni Jacob
English: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Le´ah, and served with him yet seven other years. The Children Born to Jacob

Cebuano: Sa dihang nakita sa Ginoo nga wala higugmaa ni Jacob si Lea gihimo niya nga makapanganak si Lea samtang si Raquel nagpabilin nga walay anak.
English: And when the LORD saw that Le´ah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

Cebuano: Nagmabdos si Lea ug nanganak ug batang lala ki. Miingon siya “Nakita sa Ginoo ang akong kaguol ug karon higugmaon na gayod ako sa akong bana.” Busa ginganlan niyag Ruben ang bata.
English: And Le´ah conceived, and bare a son; and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

Cebuano: Nagmabdos siya pag-usab ug nanganak gihapon siyag lalaki Miingon siya, “Gihatagan gihapon ako sa Ginoo ug lalaking anak kay nasayod man siya nga wala ako higugmaa sa akong bana.” Busa ginganlan niyag Simeon ang bata.
English: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

Cebuano: Nagmabdos na usab siya ug nanganak gihapog batang lalaki Miingon siya, “Karon higugmaon na gayod ako sa akong bana kay tulo na man ang among anak nga pulos lalaki.” Busa ginganlan niyag Levi ang bata.
English: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have borne him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

Cebuano: Unya nagmabdos pa gayod siya pag -usab ug nanganak gihapog batang lalaki. Miingon siya, “Karon daygon ko ang Ginoo.” Busa Juda ang gingalan niya sa bata. Unya mihunong siya sa pagpanganak.
English: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

Cebuano: Sa dihang wala gayod manganak si Raquel, nasina siya kang Lea ug giingnan niya si Jacob, “Hatagi akog anak kay kon dili, mamatay gayod ako.”
English: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

Cebuano: Nasuko si Jacob kang Raquel ug miingon siya “Dios ba gud ako? Siya maoy nagbuot nga dili ka manganak.”
English: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel; and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

Cebuano: Miingon si Raquel, “Ania ang akong ulipon nga si Bilha Pakigdulog kaniya aron manganak siya alang kanako ug niining paagiha mahimo akong inahan.”
English: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

Cebuano: Busa gitugyan niya si Bilha ngadto sa iyang bana ug nakigdulog si Jacob kaniya.
English: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

Cebuano: Unya nagmabdos si Bilha ug nanganak ug batang lalaki.
English: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

Cebuano: Miingon si Raquel, “Naluoy kanako ang Dios. Gidungog niya ang akong pag- ampo ug gihatagan ako niyag anak.” Busa ginganlan niyag Dan ang bata.
English: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

Cebuano: Nagmabdos pag-usab si Bilha ug lalaki gihapon ang iyang gianak.
English: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

Cebuano: Miingon si Raquel “Nakigbisog ako pag-ayo sa akong igsoon ug nakadaog ako.” Busa ginganlan niyag Neftali ang bata.
English: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naph´tali.

Cebuano: Sa dihang mihunong na si Lea sa pagpanganak iyang gihatag kang Jacob ang iyang ulipon nga si Zilfa silbing asawa ni Jacob.
English: When Le´ah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

Cebuano: Unya nanganak si Zilfa ug batang lalaki.
English: And Zilpah Le´ah's maid bare Jacob a son.

Cebuano: Ug miingon si Lea, “Palaran ako!” Busa ginganlan niyag Gad ang bata.
English: And Le´ah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

Cebuano: Si Zilfa nanganak pag-usab ug batang lalaki
English: And Zilpah Le´ah's maid bare Jacob a second son.

Cebuano: ug miingon si Lea “Pagkabulahan ko gayod! Karon ang mga kababayen-an motawag na kanakog bulahan.” Busa ginganlan niyag Aser ang bata.
English: And Le´ah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

Cebuano: Unya sa ting-ani na sa trigo miadto si Ruben sa kaumahan ug nakakaplag siyag mga mandragora ug gidala niya kini ngadto sa iyang inahan nga si Lea Si Raquel miingon kang Lea “Hatagi intawon akog pipila ka buok mandragora sa imong anak.”
English: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Le´ah. Then Rachel said to Le´ah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

Cebuano: Si Lea mitubag kaniya “Dili pa ba igo ang pag -ilog mo sa akong bana? Karon imo pa gayong kuhaon ang mga mandragora sa akong anak?” Si Raquel miingon, “Kon hatagan mo akog mandragora, mahimong padulgon ko kanimo si Jacob karong gabii.”
English: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee tonight for thy son's mandrakes.

Cebuano: Paghiuli ni Jacob gikan sa kaumahan nia nang pagkagabii, gitagbo siya ni Lea ug giingnan, “Kinahanglan nga ari ka dulog kanako niining gabhiona kay gibayran ko ikaw sa mandragora” Busa nakigdulog si Ja cob kang Lea niadtong gabhiona.
English: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Le´ah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

Cebuano: Ug gidungog sa Dios ang pag-ampo ni Lea. Nagmabdos siya ug nanganak sa ikalimang anak nila.
English: And God hearkened unto Le´ah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

Cebuano: Miingon si Lea, “Gigantihan ako sa Dios kay gihatag ko man sa akong bana ang akong ulipon.” Busa ginganlan niyag Isacar ang iyang anak.
English: And Le´ah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Is´sachar.

Cebuano: Unya nagmabdos si Lea pag -usab ug nanganak Kini ang ikaunom nilang anak nga lalaki.
English: And Le´ah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

Cebuano: Miingon si Lea, “Gihatagan akog anindot nga gasa sa Dios Karon mahalon na gayod ako sa akong bana kay unom na man ang among anak nga pulos lalaki.” Busa ginganlan niyag Zabulon ang bata.
English: And Le´ah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons: and she called his name Zeb´ulun.

Cebuano: Unya nanganak siyag babaye nga iyang ginganlag Dina.
English: And afterward she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

Cebuano: Unya nahinumdom ang Dios k ang Raquel. Gitubag niya ang pag -ampo ni Raquel aron siya manganak.
English: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

Cebuano: Ug nagmabdos siya ug nanganak ug batang lalaki. Miingon siya, “Gikuha sa Dios ang nakapaulaw kanako.
English: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

Cebuano: Hatagan pa unta ako sa Ginoo ug laing anak nga lalaki” Busa ging anlan niyag Jose ang bata. Ang Panagsabot ni Jacob ug ni Laban
English: and she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son. The Trickery of Laban and Jacob

Cebuano: Human matawo si Jose miingon si Jacob kang Laban “Mopauli na ako sa amo.
English: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

Cebuano: Ihatag kanako ang akong mga asawa nga akong gialagaran kanimo ug ang akong mga anak ug mopauli na ako Nasayod ka kon giunsa ko ikaw pag - alagad.”
English: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

Cebuano: Miingon si Laban kaniya, “Tugoti ako sa pagsulti niini: nasayran ko pinaagi sa akong mga pagpanagna nga gipanalanginan ako sa Ginoo tungod kanimo.
English: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favor in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

Cebuano: Busa pangayo sa gusto mong suhol kay ihatag ko kini kanimo.”
English: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

Cebuano: Si Jacob m itubag kaniya “Nasayod ka nga naghago ako pag -ayo alang kanimo ug nga misanay pag -ayo ang imong kahayopan ubos sa akong pag - atiman.
English: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

Cebuano: Kaniadto sa wala pa ako dinhi, diyutay ra sila. Apan karon daghan na kaayo sila. Gipanalanginan ka sa Ginoo tungod kanako. Karon angay nang atimanon ko na usab ang akong kaugalingon.”
English: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now, when shall I provide for mine own house also?

Cebuano: “Unsa may ibayad ko kanimo?” nangutana si Laban. Si Jacob mitubag, “Dili ko gustong suholan mo ako. Mopadayon ako pag-atiman sa imong kahayopan kon mouyon ka sa akong kondisyon.
English: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.

Cebuano: Karong adla wa lainon ko ang tanang nating karnero nga itom ug ang tanang nating kanding nga kabang ug puntikpuntikon Kini sila mao ang suhol ko.
English: I w ill pass through all thy flock today, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

Cebuano: Masayran mo ra unya kon gilimbongan ko ikaw Kon hikaplagan mo nga may kanding ako nga dili kabang o karnero nga dili i tom, isipa kana nga gikawat ko.”
English: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

Cebuano: Mitubag si Laban, “Maayo. Uyon ako sa giingon mo.”
English: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

Cebuano: Apan niana gayong adlawa gipanguha ni Laban ang mga laki ug bayeng kanding nga kabang ug puntikpuntikon ingon man ang mga karnerong itom Ug iya kining gipabantayan sa iyang mga anak nga lalaki.
English: And he removed that day the he goats that were ring-streaked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

Cebuano: Unya mipahilayo siya kang Jacob Mipanaw siya dala ang maong mga kahayopan sa gilay -on nga balig tulo ka adlaw nga panaw Si J acob maoy nag-atiman sa ubang kahayopan ni Laban.
English: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

Cebuano: Unya mikuha si Jacob ug buhing mga sanga sa alamo sa almendras ug sa platano ug gilaphaklaphak niya pagkuha ang panit niini aron makita nga may mga laphak na nga puti kini.
English: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

Cebuano: Gibutang niya kining mga sangaha atubangan sa imnanan sa mga hayop kay magtakmagay man didto ang mga hayop inig-inom nila.
English: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

Cebuano: Busa ang mga kanding nga hitakmagan atubangan sa maong mga sanga nanganak ug kabang ug puntikpuntik.
English: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ring-streaked, speckled, and spotted.

Cebuano: Gilain ni Jacob ang mga karnero ug gipaatubang niya sila sa mga kabang ug ang lubos itom nga mga hayop ni Laban Niining paagiha misanay ang mga hayop ni Jacob ug wala kini niya itipon sa mga hayop ni Laban.
English: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ring-streaked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.

Cebuano: Kon maghabal na ang tambok nga mga hayop ibutang ni Jacob ang mga sanga sa ilang atubangan duol sa imnanan aron sila magmabdos duol sa mga sanga.
English: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

Cebuano: Apan wala niya ibutang ang mga sanga sa atubangan sa n iwang nga mga hayop. Busa ang mga niwang iya ni Laban samtang ang mga tambok iya ni Jacob.
English: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

Cebuano: Ug nadato siya pag -ayo ug daghan kaayo siyag mga kahayopan mga ulipon, mga kamelyo ug mga asno.
English: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

Cebuano: Nakabalita si Jacob n ga ang mga lalaking anak ni Laban nag -ingon, “Ang tanang butang sa atong amahan gikuha ni Jacob Nadato siya gumikan sa katigayonan sa atong amahan.”
English: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

Cebuano: Nakamatikod usab siya nga ang tinagdan ni Laban kaniya lahi na kay sa una.
English: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

Cebuano: Unya miingon ang Ginoo kaniya, “Pauli sa yuta sa imong mga ginikanan ug sa imong kaparyentihan ug ubanan ko ikaw.”
English: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

Cebuano: Busa gipasugoan ni Jacob si Raquel ug si Lea nga makigkita kaniya didto sa sibsibanan sa iyang kahayopan.
English: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Le´ah to the field unto his flock,

Cebuano: Giingnan niya sila “Namatikdan ko nga ang inyong amahan lahi nag tinagdan kanako. Apan giubanan ako sa Dios sa akong amahan.
English: and said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

Cebuano: Kamong duha nasayod nga gialagaran ko ang inyong amahan kutob sa akong mahimo.
English: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

Cebuano: Apan gilimbongan niya ako ug kanapulo niya usab-usaba ang akong suhol Apan wala motugot ang Dios nga pasipad-an niya ako.
English: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten tim es; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

Cebuano: Sa dihang miingon ang inyong amahan nga ang mga kanding nga kabang maoy isuhol niya kanako ang tanan nanganak ug kabang Ug sa dihang miingon siya nga ang may mga badlisbadlis maoy isuhol niya kanako ang tanan nanganak ug may badlisbadlis.
English: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ring-streaked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ring-streaked.

Cebuano: Gikuhaan sa Dios ug daghang kahayopan ang inyong amahan ug gihatag kanako.
English: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

Cebuano: “Sa panahon sa tingpangulag sa kahayopan nagdamgo ako Sa maong damgo, nakita ko nga ang mga laking kanding nga may mga badlisbadlis mga kabang ug mga puntikpuntikon mihabal sa mga baye.
English: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ring-streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

Cebuano: Ug sa maong damgo miingon kanako ang anghel sa Dios ‘Jacob’ ug mitubag ako, ‘Ginoo, unsa man?’
English: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.

Cebuano: Mipadayon siya pag -ingon, ‘Ang tanang kanding nga mihabal may mga badlisbadlis, mga kabang ug mga puntikpuntikon Gihimo ko kini kay nakita ko ang tanang gibuhat ni Laban kanimo.
English: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ring-streaked, speckled, and grizzled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

Cebuano: Ako ang Dios nga nagpakita kanimo didto sa Betel diin nagpahiluna ka ug bato silbing handomanan ug gibuboan mo kinig lana ug naghimo kag panaad. Karon, pangandam ug biyai kining yutaa ug pauli sa imong yutang natawhan.’”
English: I am the God of Beth–el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

Cebuano: Mitubag si Raquel ug si Lea kang Jacob “May masunod pa ba gud kami sa among amahan?
English: And Rachel and Le´ah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

Cebuano: Dili ba giisip man kami niya nga mga langyaw? Gibaligya kami niya ug nagasto na niya ang salapi.
English: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

Cebuano: Ang tanang bahandi nga gikuha sa Dios gikan sa among amahan amoa ug sa among mga anak. Busa buhata ang giingon sa Dios kanimo.”
English: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do. Jacob Flees from Laban

Cebuano: Busa nangandam si Jacob sa pagpauli ngadto sa iy ang amahan nga nagpuyo sa yuta sa Canaan. Iyang gipakabayo sa mga kamelyo ang iyang mga anak ug mga asawa ug giabog niya ang tanan niyang kahay opan aron mag - una kaniya Gidala usab niya ang tanan nga napanag -iya niya sa Mesopotamia.
English: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels; and he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Pa´dan –a´ram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

Cebuano: Sa dihang milakaw si Laban aron pagpanupi sa mga karnero gikawat ni Raquel ang mga diosdios sa iyang amahan.
English: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the imag es that were her father's.

Cebuano: Gilingla ni Jacob si Laban nga Arameanhon Wala siya magpahibalo kaniya nga mogikan siya.
English: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

Cebuano: Gidala niya ang tanan niyang kabtangan ug mikagiw siya Mitabok siya sa Suba sa Eufrates ug mipaingon sa Bukid sa Gilead. Gigukod ni Laban si Jacob
English: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gil´e-ad.

Cebuano: Human molabay ang tulo ka adlaw gisuginlan si Laban nga mikagiw si Jacob.
English: And it was told Laban on the third day, that Jacob was fled.

Cebuano: Busa gidala niya ang iyang mga tawo ug giagpas nila si Jacob Mipanaw silag pito ka adlaw hangtod nga naapsan nila si Jacob didto sa Bukid sa Gilead.
English: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gil´e-ad.

Cebuano: Ug niadtong gabhiona ang Dios mipakita kang Laban nga Arameanhon pinaagi sa damgo ug miingon, “Ayaw gayod pasipad-i si Jacob.”
English: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

Cebuano: Naapsan ni Laban si Jacob nga nagkampo didto sa kabungtoran. Nagkampo usab si Laban didto sa Bukid sa Gilead.
English: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gil´e-ad.

Cebuano: Unya si Laban miingon kang Jacob, “Nganong gilimbongan mo man ako ug gidala mo ang akong mga anak nga morag mga binihag sa gubat?
English: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

Cebuano: Nganong milakaw ka man nga wala mananghid kanako? Kon nananghid ka pa, pagikanon ko unta ikaw uban sa kalipay ug mga pag -awit, dinuyogan sa tamborin ug sa alpa.
English: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

Cebuano: Wala mo gani ako pahagka sa akong mga apo ug mga anak agig panamilit Pagkadakong binuang niining imong gibuhat!
English: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

Cebuano: Mahimo nga pasipad-an ko ikaw apan kagabii ang Dios sa imong amahan miingon kanako, ‘Ayaw baya pasipad-i si Jacob.’
English: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

Cebuano: Nasayod ako nga milayas ka kay gimingaw ka na sa inyo apan nganong gikawat mo man ang akong mga dios?”
English: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

Cebuano: Si Jacob mitubag, “Nahadlok ako nga dili mo pakuyogon kanako ang imong mga anak nga babaye.
English: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

Cebuano: Apan bahin sa imong mga dios kon hikit-an mo gani kini sa usa kanamo angay siyang patyon. Atubangan sa atong mga tawo pangitag bisan unsa nga imoha ug kuhaa kini” Apan wala mas ayod si Jacob nga si Raquel maoy nagkawat sa mga diosdios.
English: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

Cebuano: Busa misulod si Laban sa tolda ni Jacob ug gisusi niya kini Misulod usab siya sa tolda ni Lea ug sa tolda sa duha ka ulipong babaye apan wala niya hikaplagi didto ang iyang mga diosdios. Unya miadto siya sa tolda ni Raquel.
English: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Le´ah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Le´ah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

Cebuano: Apan didto tagoi ni Raquel ang mga diosdios sa ilalom sa muntora sa kamelyo ug iya kining gilingkoran. Gisusi ni Laban ang tibuok tolda apan wala niya kini hikaplagi.
English: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

Cebuano: Miingon si Raquel sa iyan g amahan, “Ayaw ug kasuko kanako nga dili ako makatindog sa imong atubangan kay giregla ako” Mipadayon si Laban sa pagpangita apan wala gayod niya hikaplagi ang iyang mga diosdios.
English: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

Cebuano: Unya si Jacob wala na makapugong sa iyang kaugalingon ug masuk -anon nga miingon kang Laban, “Unsa may akong sala kanimo nga imo man akong gigukod?
English: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

Cebuano: Karon nga nasusi mo na ang tanan kong kabtangan unsa may nakaplagan mo nga imoha? Kon aduna dad -a diri sa gawas aron nga ang imo ug akong mga tawo makakita ug silay mohukom kinsa kanato ang husto.
English: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

Cebuano: Nitipon ako kanimo sa 20 ka tuig ug wala gayod mahitabo nga wala manganak ang imong mga kanding ug mga karnero apan wala gayod ako makakaon ug karne sa laking karnero nga imoha.
English: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

Cebuano: Kon may karnero nga gitukob sa ihalas nga mga mananap wala ko kini dad-a kanimo aron ipakita nga an g nahitabo dili akong sayop kondili giilisan ko ang karnero. Gipabayran mo kanako ang gikawat nga karnero panahon sa adlaw o sa gabii.
English: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

Cebuano: Sa daghang higayon giantos ko ang kainit sa adlaw ug ang katugnaw sa gabii ug wala akoy maayong kinatulgan.
English: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

Cebuano: Mao kini ang akong nahimo sulod sa 20 ka tuig sa akong pagpuyo tipon kanimo. Napulog-upat ka tuig ang pag -alagad ko kanimo alang sa duha mo ka anak nga babaye ug unom ka tuig alang sa imong mga kahayopan Apan kanapulo mo usab-usaba ang akong suhol.
English: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house: I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle; and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

Cebuano: Kon wala pa ako ubani sa Dios sa akong amahan nga mao ang Dios ni Abraham ug ang Dios nga gisimba ni Isaac gipapahawa mo na unta ako nga walay dala Apan nakita sa Dios ang akong kalisod ug ang akong nahimo kanimo ug kagabii gipahimangnoan ka niya.” Ang Gikasabotan ni Jacob ug ni Laban
English: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou h adst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

Cebuano: Unya mitubag si Laban kang Jacob “Kining mga babaye akong mga anak ug ang ilang mga anak akong mga apo Ang mga kahayopan akoa. Akoa ang tanan nga nakita mo Apan karon unsa pa may mahimo k o sa akong mga anak o sa akong mga apo?
English: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have borne?

Cebuano: Busa maghimo kitag kasabotan ug magpundok kitag mga bato silbing handomanan nato bahin niini.”
English: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

Cebuano: Unya nag-ugbok si Jacob ug bato agig handomanan
English: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

Cebuano: ug gisugo niya ang iyang mga tawo sa pagkuhag mga bato ug ila kinin g gipatongpatong. Unya nangaon sila tupad sa batong tinapok.
English: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

Cebuano: Ginganlan kini ni Laban ug Jegar -sahaduta, apan Galeed ang gingalan ni Jacob niini.
English: And Laban called it Je´gar–sahadu´tha: but Jacob called it Ga´leed.

Cebuano: Miingon si Laban, “Kining pinundok nga mga bato handomanan nato.” Busa ginganlag Galeed ang maong dapit.
English: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Ga´leed,

Cebuano: Ug miingon usab si Laban “Bantayan unta kita ni Yahweh samtang magkalinay-anay kita.” Busa ginganlan usab ug Mispa ang maong dapit.
English: and Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

Cebuano: Mipadayon si Laban sa pag -ingon, “Kon daugdaogon mo ang akong mga anak o mangasawa kag laing mga babaye bisan ako dili ma sayod niini hinumdomi nga ang Dios nagtan-aw kanato.”
English: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

Cebuano: Unya miingon si Laban kang Jacob “Ania ang gipatongpatong ko nga mga bato tali kanato ug ania ang handomanan nga bato.
English: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

Cebuano: Kining gipatongpatong nga mga bato ug kining giugbok nga bato maoy atong mga utlanan. Dili ako molatas niining gipundok nga mga bato aron sa pagpakig-away kanimo o ikaw molatas niini aron sa pagpakig-away kanako.
English: this heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

Cebuano: Maoy atong pahukmon ang Dios ni Abraham ug ang Dios ni Nahor” Unya nanumpa si Jacob sa ngalan sa Dios nga gisimba ni Isaac nga iyang amahan.
English: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

Cebuano: Nag-ihaw siyag usa ka hayop ug iyang gihalad didto sa bukid ug g idapit niya ang iyang mga tawo sa pagpangaon Human sila mangaon didto sila mangatulog sa bukid niadtong gabhiona.
English: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

Cebuano: Sayo sa buntag gipanghagkan ni Laban ang iyang mga apo ug mga anak agig panamilit ug gipanalanginan niya sila. Unya mipauli siya sa ila.
English: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and bl essed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

Cebuano: Mipadayon si Jacob sa iyang panaw ug gisugat siyag mga anghel sa Dios.
English: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

Cebuano: Sa pagkakita ni Jacob kanila, miingon siya, “Mga sundalo kini sa Dios.” Busa ginganlan niyag Mahanaim ang maong dapit.
English: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahana´im.

Cebuano: Nagsugo si Jacob ug mga tawo sa pag -una kaniya ngadto sa iyang igsoon nga si Esau didto sa Seir sa nasod sa Edomea.
English: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Se´ir, the country of Edom.

Cebuano: Gisugo niya sila nga sultihan si Esau niini: “Si Jacob ang imong sulugoon didto mipuyo tipon kang Laban ug karon pa lamang mopauli.
English: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

Cebuano: Aduna na siyay daghang baka asno, karnero, kanding ug mga ulipon Gipasugoan ka niya aron pagsugilon kanimo niini basin na lag mahim uot ka kaniya.”
English: and I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

Cebuano: Sa nahibalik na ang mga si nugo ni Jacob miingon sila, “Didto na kami sa imong igsoon nga si Esau ug nagpaingon na siya nganhi aron pagtagbo kanimo. May kuyog siyang ka tawo.”
English: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

Cebuano: Nahadlok ug nabalaka pag-ayo si Jacob. Busa gibahin niya sa duha ka panon ang iyang mga tawo ingon ma n ang iyang mga karnero kanding, baka ug mga kamelyo.
English: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

Cebuano: Naghunahuna siya nga kon ugaling atakihon ni Esau ang unang pundok makahimo pag-ikyas ang ikaduha.
English: and said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

Cebuano: Unya nag -ampo si Jacob “Dios sa akong apohan nga si Abraham ug sa akong amahan nga si Isaac pamatia intawon ako! Ginoo, ikaw nag -ingon kanako, ‘Pauli sa inyo ug sa imong kaparyentihan ug salig nga walay mahitabo kanimo.’
English: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

Cebuano: Dili ako takos sa tanan mong kaluoy ug kaayo kanako ng a imong sulugoon. Mitabok ako sa Jordan nga walay dala gawas sa akong sungko d apan karon mibalik ako uban niining duha ka pundok.
English: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast showed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

Cebuano: Busa luwasa intawon ako gikan sa mga kamot sa akong igsoon nga si Esau Nahadlok ako nga siya mipaingon nganhi aron pamatyon kaming tanan lakip ang mga babaye ug kabataan.
English: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

Cebuano: Hinumdomi ang imong saad n ga walay daotang mahitabo kanako ug nga hatagan mo akog daghang kaliwat nga dili maihap sama kadaghan sa balas sa baybayon.”
English: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

Cebuano: Human siya magpalabay sa gabii niadtong dapita nagpili siyag gasa alang sa iyang igsoon nga si Esau.
English: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

Cebuano: Kini ang iyang gigasa: 200 ka baye ug 20 ka laking kanding, 200 ka baye ug 20 ka laking karnero, 30 ka gatasan nga kamelyo lakip ang mga anak nila, 40 ka baye nga baka ug 10 ka toro ug 20 ka baye ug 10 ka laking asno.
English: two hundred she goats and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams, thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine and ten bulls, twent y she asses and ten foals.

Cebuano: Matag panon gipadumala niya sa usa ka sulugoon ug giingnan niya, “Una kamo kanako ug kinahanglan nga dili magkadug-ol ang matag panon.”
English: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

Cebuano: Gimandoan niya ang unang sulugoon “Kon mangutana kaninyo ang akong igsoon nga si Esau kon kinsa ang inyong agalon asa kamo paingon ug kinsay tag-iya niining kahayopan,
English: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

Cebuano: ingna siya, ‘Kini iya ni Jacob nga imong sulugoon Iya kining igasa kanimo ug nagsunod siya kanamo.’”
English: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

Cebuano: Mao usab kini ang iyang gisugo sa ikaduha ug sa ikatulo ingon man sa tanan nga nagdumala sa nagsunod nga mga panon,
English: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

Cebuano: “Ingna si Esau ‘Ang imong sulugoon ng a si Jacob nagsunod kanamo’” Nagtuo si Jacob nga maluoy kaniya ang iyang igsoon tungod sa mga gasa nga iyang gipadala pag-una ug nga pasayloon siya ni Esau.
English: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

Cebuano: Gipadala niya pag -una ang mga gasa ug mipahulay siya didto sa kampo niadtong gabhiona. Nakigdumog si Jacob didto sa Peniel
English: So went the present over before him; and himself lodged that night in the company. Jacob Wrestles at Peniel

Cebuano: Niadtong gabhiona mibangon si Jacob ug gidala niya ang duha niya ka asawa, ang duha niya ka ulipong babaye ug ang 11 niya ka anak ug mitabok sila sa tabokanan sa Suba sa Jaboc.
English: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

Cebuano: Human niya ikatabok sila iya usab nga gipatabo k ang tanan niyang kabtangan.
English: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

Cebuano: Siya na lamang ang nagpabilin Unya may tawong nakigdumog kaniya hangtod sa kaadlawon.
English: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a m an with him until the breaking of the day.

Cebuano: Sa pagkamatikod sa tawo nga dili siya makadaog sa ilang panagdumog giigo niya ang dapidapi ni Jacob ug naligas ang lutahan niini.
English: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

Cebuano: Miingon ang tawo, “Buhii ako kay hayag na” Apan si Jacob mitubag, “Dili ko ikaw buhian hangtod nga panalanginan mo ako.”
English: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. A nd he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

Cebuano: Nangutana ang tawo, “Unsay imong ngalan?” Mitubag siya, “Jacob.”
English: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

Cebuano: Ang tawo miingon “Dili na Jacob ang imong ngalan kondili Israel kay nakigdumog ka sa Dios ug sa mga tawo ug midaog ka.”
English: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

Cebuano: Si Jacob miingon, “Tug-ani lagi ako sa imong ngalan” Apan mitubag ang tawo, “Nganong nangutana ka man sa akong ngalan?” Unya gipanalanginan niya si Jacob.
English: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

Cebuano: Miingon si Jacob “Nakakita na gayod ako s a nawong sa Dios ug buhi gihapon ako.” Busa ginganlan niyag Peniel ang maong dapit.
English: And Jacob called the name of the place Peni´el: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

Cebuano: Misubang na ang adlaw sa pagbiya ni Jacob sa Peniel ug nagkiang siya tungod sa nalisa niyang dapidapi.
English: And as he passed over Penu´el the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

Cebuano: Busa, hangtod karon ang mga kaliwat ni Israel dili mokaon sa unod sa dapidapi sa mananap kay diha mang bahina sa lawas naigo si Jacob.
English: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shra nk, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day; because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

Cebuano: Nakita ni Jacob si Esau uban sa ka tawo nga nagpaingon kaniya busa gibahinbahin niya ang iyang mga anak kanila ni Lea, ni Raquel ug sa duha ka ulipon nga babaye.
English: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Le´ah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

Cebuano: Maoy iyang gipauna ang mga ulipon ug ang ilang kabataan unya gipasunod si Lea ug ang iyang mga anak ug gipaulahi niya si Raquel ug si Jose.
English: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Le´ah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

Cebuano: Unya miuna si Jacob kanila ug miyukbo sa makapito hangtod miabot siya duol kang Esau.
English: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

Cebuano: Apan midagan si Esau aron pagtagbo kang Jacob ug migakos ug mihalok kaniya. Nanghilak silang duha.
English: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

Cebuano: Ug sa pagkakita ni Esau sa mga babaye ug sa mga kabataan, nangutana siya, “Kinsa man kining mga kuyog nimo?” Mitubag si Jacob “Kini sila mao ang mga anak nga gikaluoy sa Dios paghatag kanako.”
English: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children, and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

Cebuano: Unya miduol ang mga ulipon nga mga babaye uban sa ilang mga anak ug miyukbo.
English: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

Cebuano: Miduol usab si Lea ug ang iyang mga anak ug sa kataposan si Raquel ug si Jose nga miyukbo usab.
English: And Le´ah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

Cebuano: Nangutana si Esau “Unsa man diay kadtong laing panon nga akong gikatagbo? Unsa may buot ipasabot niadto?” Si Jacob mitubag “Igasa ko kadto kanimo aron mahimuot ka kanako.”
English: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

Cebuano: Apan miingon si Esau “Igsoon, aduna akoy akoa nga igo na kanako Busa ayaw na lamang akog hatagi.”
English: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

Cebuano: Miingon si Jacob “Dili ma himo. Kon tinuod nga gipasaylo mo na ako dawata ang akong gasa kanimo Alang kanako ang pagtan -aw sa imong nawong sama ra nga nagtan-aw ako sa nawong sa Dios karon nga gidawat mo ako.
English: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

Cebuano: Busa dawata intawon kining akong gasa kanimo Maayo kaayo kanako ang Dios ug gihatagan niya ako sa tanan kong gikinahanglan” Namugos gayod si Jacob kang Esau busa gidawat na lamang ni Esau ang gasa.
English: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

Cebuano: Miingon si Esau, “Tana! Manglakaw na kita ug akoy mag-una.”
English: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

Cebuano: Mitubag si Jacob, “Nasayod ka nga luya ang mga bata ug anaa p ay anakan nga mga karnero ug mga baka nga nagkinahanglan sa akong pag-atiman. Kon pugson sila sa paglakawg paspas bisag usa lang ka adlaw, mangamatay silang tanan.
English: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me; and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

Cebuano: Busa una lang kanamo ug mohinayhinay ra akog s unod. Agdon lang nako ang gikusgon sa linaktan sa mga hayop ug sa mga kabataan hangtod maabtan ka namo sa Seir sa Edomea.”
English: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before hi s servant; and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Se´ir.

Cebuano: Si Esau miingon, “Kon mao kana, ibilin ko kanimo ang pipila sa akong mga tawo.” Apan si Jacob mitubag “Pagkamaayo nimo kanako apan ayaw na lang kana buhata.”
English: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

Cebuano: Busa niadtong adlawa mibalik si Esau balik sa Seir.
English: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Se´ir.

Cebuano: Apan si Jacob mipaingon sa Sucot ug didto nagbalay siya ug naghimog silonganan sa iyang mga hayop. Busa ginganlan ang maong dapit ug Sucot.
English: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

Cebuano: Gikan sa Mesopotamia miabot si Jacob sa siyudad sa Siquem sa yuta sa Canaan nga walay kadaot nga nahitabo Nagkampo siya didto sa usa ka uma nga atbang sa siyudad.
English: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Pa´dan–a´ram; and pitched his tent before the city.

Cebuano: Gipalit niya ang maong uma gikan sa mga kaliwat ni Hamor nga amahan ni Siquem ug 100 ka salapi.
English: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.

Cebuano: Unya naghimo siya didtog halaran ug ginganlan niya kinig El ang Dios sa Israel.
English: And he erected there an altar, and called it El–El´ohe–Israel.

Cebuano: Usa ka adlaw niana si Dina ang anak nga babaye ni Jacob ug ni Lea namisita sa mga babaye sa maong dapit.
English: And Dinah the daughter of Le´ah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

Cebuano: Si Siquem nga anak ni Hamor ang Hibihanon ug pangulo sa maong dapit nakakita kang Dina ug gipugos niya kini pagdala ug gilugos.
English: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

Cebuano: Apan nakagusto siya kang Dina ug nahigugma kaniya busa gialam -alaman niya si Dina.
English: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

Cebuano: Busa giingnan ni Siquem ang iyang amahan “Ipamalaye ako aron maasawa ko siya.”
English: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

Cebuano: Nakabalita si Jacob nga gilug os ang iyang anak apan kay ang iy ang mga lalaking anak didto pa man sa kaumahan uban sa iyang mga kahayopan, wala siyay gihimo ug gihulat niya nga mahiuli sila.
English: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

Cebuano: Ang amahan ni Siquem nga si Hamor miadto kang Jacob aron pagpamalaye
English: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

Cebuano: ug nahiatol kini sa paghiuli sa mga anak ni Jacob Sa pagkadungog nila sa nahitabo, misilaob ang ilang kasuko ngadto kang Siquem tungod sa iyang pagpakaulaw sa katawhan sa Israel.
English: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

Cebuano: Miingon si Hamor kanila “Ang akong anak nga si Siquem nahigugma sa imong anak busa hangyoon ko ikaw nga ipaasawa siya ni Siquem.
English: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

Cebuano: Mahiusa kita pinaagi sa kaminyoon Ipaasawa namo sa among mga ulitawo ang inyong mga dalaga ug ang inyong mga ulitawo mahimo usab nga mangasawa sa among mga dalaga.
English: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

Cebuano: Ug makahimo kamo sa pagpuyo dinhi sa among dapit tipon kanamo Makapuyo kamo bisan asa makapamatigayon ug makapanag -iyag mga kabtangan.”
English: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

Cebuano: Unya miingon si Siquem kang Jacob ug sa mga lalaking igsoon ni Dina “Tugoti ako sa pagpangasawa kang Dina ug ihatag ko bisan unsay pangayoon ninyo.
English: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

Cebuano: Isulti lamang kon pila ang bugay ug mga gasa nga gusto ninyo ug ihatag ko kaninyo basta maasawa ko lang si Dina.”
English: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

Cebuano: Ang mga lalaking anak ni Jacob malimbongon nga mitubag kang Siquem ug sa iyang amahan nga si Hamor kay gilugos man ni Siquem si Dina.
English: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

Cebuano: Miingon sila, “Dili kami makatugot nga ang among igsoon mam inyo sa dili tinuli kay makauulaw kana kanamo.
English: and they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

Cebuano: Mosugot lamang kami kon magpatuli ang tanan ninyong lalaki sama kanamo.
English: but in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

Cebuano: Unya makapangasawa na kamo sa among mga dalaga ug kami usab makapangasawa na sa inyong mga dalaga. Ug mopuyo kami tipon kaninyo ug maghiusa na kita.
English: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

Cebuano: Apan kon dili kamo magpatuli, mamahawa kami ug dad-on namo si Dina.”
English: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

Cebuano: Nakauyon si Hamor ug si Siquem niini
English: And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem Hamor's son.

Cebuano: busa wala maglangan si Siquem sa pagpatuli kay nahigugma man siya kang Dina. Si Siquem mao ang labing tinamod nga sakop sa iyang pamilya.
English: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honorable than all the house of his father.

Cebuano: Miadto si Hamor ug ang iyang anak nga si Siquem sa dapit tigomanan nga didto sa ganghaan sa lungsod ug giingnan nila ang ilang katagilungsod,
English: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

Cebuano: “Mahigalaon kining mga tawhana busa tugotan ta sila sa pagpuyo dinhi sa atong dapit nga walay manghilabot kanila, total dako man kining atong yuta. Mangasawa kita sa ilang mga dalaga ug ato usab nga ipaasawa kanila ang atong mga dalaga.
English: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

Cebuano: Apan kining mga t awhana mouyon lamang nga mopuyo tipon kanato ug makighiusa kanato kon kitang tanang mga lalaki magpatuli sama kanila.
English: Only herein will the m en consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

Cebuano: Sa ingon niini, maato na ang ilang mga kahayopan, mga kabtangan ug mga binuhi. Busa mouyon kita nga sila motipon kanato.”
English: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

Cebuano: Ang tanang molupyo nga nagtigom didto sa ganghaan sa maong lungsod miuyon ug nagpatuli ang tanan nilang mga lalaki.
English: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

Cebuano: Sa ikatulo nga adlaw, samtang ang tanang lalaki nag -antos pa sa kasakit sa ilang tuli, duha sa mga anak ni Jacob, si Simeon ug si Levi nga mga igsoon ni Dina, mikuha sa ilang mga espada Misekreto sila pag -adto sa lungsod ug gipamatay nila ang tanang lalaki.
English: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

Cebuano: Gipatay nila si Hamor ug ang iyang anak nga si Siquem ug gikuha nila si Dina sa balay ni Siquem ug nanglakaw sila.
English: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

Cebuano: Ang uban usab nga mga anak ni Jacob miadto sa lungsod ug gitiwasan ang mga samdan ug gikuha nila ang tanang butang nga may bili tungod kay gipanamastamasan man ang ilang igsoon.
English: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

Cebuano: Gidala usab nila ang mga karnero mga b aka, mga asno ug uban pang kabtangan nga didto sa maong lungsod ug sa mga kaumahan.
English: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

Cebuano: Gidala nila ang tanang bahandi ug ang tanan nga didto sa kabalayan ug gipamihag nila ang tanang babaye lakip ang mga kabataan.
English: and all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

Cebuano: Miingon si Jacob kang Simeon ug kang Levi, “Gihatagan gayod ninyo ako ug kasamok Karon gidumtan na ako sa mga Canaanhon ug sa mga Perisihanon ug sa tanang molupyo niining dapita Diyutay ra ang akong mga tawo. Kon maghiusa sila ug sulongon nila ako mahurot ug kamatay ang tibuok kong pamilya lakip ako.”
English: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the i nhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Per´izzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

Cebuano: Apan mitubag sila, “Dili kami makatugot nga ang among igsoon ipakasama lamang sa usa ka daotang babaye.”
English: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?

Cebuano: Ang Dios miingon kang Jacob “Pangandam sa pag -adto sa Betel ug adto didto puyo. Paghimog halaran didto alang sa Dios nga mipakita kanimo sa dihang mikagiw ka gikan kang Esau nga imong igsoon.”
English: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth –el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

Cebuano: Busa giingnan ni Jacob ang iyang panimalay ug ang tanang kauban niya “Isalikway ninyo ang inyong dala nga mga diosdios nga langyaw Hinloi ninyo ang inyong kaugalingon ug pagsul-ob kamog limpyong mga bisti.
English: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
